This Policy document is intended to establish guidelines for managing employee attendance and leave, ensuring fairness, compliance with legal requirements, and maintaining productivity. It aims to provide clear guidelines for marking attendance, for requesting and approving leave, and provide detailed information on the leave types and leave numbers as applicable.

Any questions and suggestions on the implementation of the policy should be directed to the ‘Authorized Personnel’ as mentioned in Clause 1.2.1.

For the purpose of this document, the term ‘company’ would refer to Meridian Finance & all registered legal entities under the umbrella.

Please note that this policy version shall supersede all earlier versions. Meridian Finance will endeavour to update this policy as required. Notwithstanding, Meridian Finance will follow the prevailing statutory requirements at the point of any application / notification.

INTRODUCTION

The Attendance and Leave Policy is designed to provide clear guidelines and detailed information for managing employees’ attendance, leave requests, and addressing unauthorized absences in our organization.

1.1 Policy Objective

The overall objectives of the policy are:

The policy helps to ensure that there is adequate staff available to meet the operational needs of the organization. By setting expectations for attendance and punctuality, the policy helps to minimize disruptions and maintain productivity.
The policy promotes fairness and consistency in managing employee attendance and leave. It establishes clear guidelines and procedures that apply to all employees, preventing favoritism or inconsistent treatment.
The policy ensures that the organization complies with applicable labor laws and regulations regarding employee attendance and leave entitlements. It helps to protect the rights of employees and ensures that the organization meets its legal obligations.
The policy provides a framework for employees to request and managers to approve leave. This allows for effective planning of work schedules and resource allocation, ensuring that work responsibilities are adequately covered during employee absences.
Record Keeping and Reporting: The policy establishes procedures for maintaining accurate attendance and leave records. This enables payroll processing, performance evaluations, and other administrative purposes, ensuring accurate record-keeping and reporting.

1.2 Policy Management

1.2.1 Policy Application and Interpretation

This policy will be in effect from _________.

The Company’s Compensation & Benefits Team and the respective BHR SPOCs will resolve any questions regarding the interpretation and application of this policy. Any exceptions to the Policy will require CHRO’s written approval.

1.2.2 Policy Amendments and Updates
The Company reserves the right to amend this policy at any time. When and where a change in this policy is made the company undertakes to notify the employees as soon as feasible.

1.3 Responsibilities, Compliance

The Company should effectively communicate the policy to all employees, ensuring that they understand their rights, responsibilities, and the procedures for requesting and reporting leave. Training sessions or informational materials (such as Employee Handbook) are provided to ensure clarity at the time of on-boarding.
The Company is responsible for accurately calculating and providing employees with their entitled leave, and other types of authorized absences, in accordance with legal requirements and company policies.
Employees are expected to familiarize themselves with the Attendance and Leave policy and comply with its provisions. This includes understanding the types of leave available, eligibility criteria, documentation requirements, and any restrictions or limitations.
.

ATTENDANCE

Scope
This policy applies to all permanent employees as well as Interns within the company. Retainers are expected to adhere to these guidelines as guiding principles.

There are two major shifts to which most of the employees are assigned to:
Flexi Shift (Office Based Role)
General Shift

Flexi Shift (Office Based Role in specific locations) -
Employees falling under this shift category are required to mark attendance within the Geo coordinates of their base location only.
All the eligible employees in grades OL I & below are required to mandatorily Punch-in and Punch-out in the HR portal on all working days.
Employees should login/logout using the the HR portal app only.
Regularization of attendance allowed within 30 days only in case the employee has missed to punch out his/her attendance.
General Shift, Employees falling under this shift category are required to mark attendance within the Geo coordinates of their base location only.
Regularization allowed in case of missed marking attendance.
Flexi Shift Guidelines
Eligibility
This policy applies to all permanent employees of Meridian Finance & all registered legal entities under the umbrella who all are office-based employees in non-field roles and are placed in any one of the below mentioned locations in tier 1 cities:
Delhi & NCR
Mumbai & Navi Mumbai
Kolkata`
Chennai
Bengaluru
Pune
Ahmedabad
Hyderabad

Core Working Hours
All the eligible employees are required to be physically available at their defined base location during the core working hours which is from 11 am to 5 pm on all the working days (including the Working Saturdays as applicable to the employees based on his/her roles) as per the attendance roster applicable to them respectively.

Outside of these hours employees can choose their start time/Punch in from 8 am onwards and End times/Punch out provided they must complete their dedicated working hours i.e. 09 (NINE) hours on every working day.

Punch in/Punch Out Guidelines
All the eligible employees in grades OL I & below are required to mandatorily Punch-in and Punch-out in the HR portal on all working days.
In case any employee fails to punch out on any working day then for that particular day, full day will be considered as “Absent”.
Employees availing half-day will be eligible for flexi-time option for that day.

Guidelines for Late sign-ins & Half Days
Employees are expected to sign in for work between 8 am to 11 am. Any sign-ins post 11 am will be considered as late arrival and the the HR portal portal will flag this as a “Late coming”. No grace period will be provided for late coming.
Employees are allowed to arrive late beyond 11 AM on a maximum of three occasions per month.
In this case, Month will be referred to payroll calendar which is 13th of previous month to 12th of current month.
After three such instances of late arrival, each additional late arrival will result in the deduction of half a day of Privilege Leave automatically.
In case Privilege Leave balance has been exhausted/consumed the same will be treated as leave without pay.
Repeated violation of the above guidelines shall attract appropriate disciplinary measures in line with the code of conduct.

Guidelines on Attendance Regularization

All the eligible employees are mandatorily required to punch in & punch out in the the HR portal and must complete their dedicated working hours i.e. 09 (NINE) hours on every working day.

In case of any employee who have missed to Punch out his/her attendance on any working day then he/she will be required to regularize their attendance in the HR portal for that particular day within 30 Calendar Days.
General Shift/Office role Shift Guidelines
Monday to Friday is considered as working days for employees. Additionally, the first, fourth and fifth Saturdays of the month or third, fourth and fifth Saturdays of the month are also considered as working days for all eligible employees as per Annexure 4 & Annexure 5.
Official Working Hours:
The official working hours for employees on all working days (including Working Saturdays) are from 9:30 AM to 6:30 PM.
A grace period of 15 minutes is provided until 9:45 AM for employees to sign in.
Employees who sign in after 9:45 AM will be considered late to work and the the HR portal portal will flag this as a “Late coming”.
Employees are required to mark their attendance through the the HR portal application only.

Guidelines for Late Sign-ins and Half day

Employees are expected to sign in for work before 9:45 AM. Any sign-ins after this time will be considered as late arrival and the the HR portal portal will flag this as a “Late coming”.
Employees are allowed to arrive late beyond 9:45 AM on a maximum of three occasions per month.
In this case, Month will be referred to payroll calendar which is 13th of previous month to 12th of current month.
After three such instances of late arrival, each additional late arrival will result in the deduction of half a day of Privilege Leave automatically.
In case Privilege Leave balance has been exhausted/consumed the same will be treated as leave without pay.
Repeated violation of the above guidelines shall attract appropriate disciplinary measures in line with the code of conduct.
Attendance sign in post 12:00 noon will be considered as a half day leave and will be adjusted against the Privilege Leave balance.

Exception
If an employee is required to work beyond 10 pm on any given working day, the concerned Head of Department may allow the employee to come late on the next day to compensate for the extended working hours.
Only instances where the employee has received permission from the Head of Department to come late on the next day will be allowed to be regularized.
In such cases, employees will receive an auto-generated email from the HR portal (Team HR) notifying them of their eligibility to regularize their attendance. The email will provide instructions on how to proceed with the regularization process.
Sign out in case of late sitting post 10 pm and before 12 am is a must so as to identify the Late sitting in the the HR portal System. The automated regularization mail will not be triggered if the employee is signing out beyond 12 am.

Guidelines on Working Saturdays
This policy is applicable to the employees of Meridian Finance Ltd. as per the Annexure 4 & Annexure 5 attached below in a detailed manner.

The guidelines pertaining to the Working Saturdays are as follows:
There will be NO changes in the shift timings & attendance rules, (late coming, etc.,) for employees and they will remain the same as per the existing schedule.
Employees who are eligible for this policy, (as per Annexure 4 & Annexure 5) will have weekly off days on the 2nd and 3rd Saturdays or 1st & 2nd Saturdays as per their eligibility.
Any employee working on the non-working Saturday (as per their eligibility) owing to business exigencies will be doing so on voluntary basis and hence there will not be any compensatory off provided in lieu thereof.
Throughout the calendar year, there will be limited instances of a 5th Saturday, however wherever the 5th Saturday occurs in the month it will be observed as a working day.
In addition to business related work activities, the working Saturdays may also be utilized for conducting a range of activities which may include training sessions, review sessions, seminars, webinars, Rewards & Recognitions events, employee engagement activities and other similar events.

Work from Anywhere on Working Saturdays

Employees can avail of the option to Work from Anywhere (WFA) on the first Saturday of each month subject to prior approval from their immediate supervisor. This is in addition to the 05 days of Work from Anywhere that they may be eligible for.
It is mandatory for the employees to seek approval from their Immediate Supervisor PRIOR TO requesting for WFA on the first Saturday of the month.
The employees must apply and ensure their immediate supervisor’s approval at least one day in advance in the HR portal while requesting the first Saturdays of the month for WFA.
WFA is NOT permitted on the fourth and fifth Saturdays of the month.

Work from Anywhere Protocols

Employees opting for Work from Anywhere will be required to keep the following guidelines in mind

Communicate proactively with your manager and team and keep them informed about tasks, deliverables and availability.
Ensure that you are in a safe environment with appropriate network connectivity.
Avoid working from public spaces such as coffee shops, restaurants, etc.
In case any unavoidable circumstances arises where you are required to work in public space ensure that your device is not discoverable on the Wi-Fi network and use a screen shield wherever feasible.
Stay connected and participate in virtual meetings as and when required.
Follow company policies during remote work including those pertaining to security protocols and communication channels.
Ensure that the cybersecurity measures are adhered to and that sensitive company information and data are appropriately handled while working remotely.
Ensure that you follow the appropriate dress code guidelines when attending meetings virtually.
Maintain professionalism in all virtual interactions, meetings and communications.
Ensure that your device/s are protected and stored correctly when not in use.

Outdoor Duty (OD)
Scope

Whenever an employee is required to report to a location other than their designated workplace for official work, it is considered as outdoor duty (in the HR portal’s attendance & time off module it is called as Outstation Duty-OD).

Application and Approval Process
For any outdoor duty, employees are required to complete an application on the the HR portal platform in advance, either on the same day or within one day after taking the outdoor duty.
Once the application is submitted on the HR portal, it will be assigned to the immediate supervisor in the system for approval.

Attendance Marking
The employees are required to mark their attendance through the the HR portal App only.
Failure to report to duty without prior intimation to Immediate Supervisor/HR Manager or failure to report to duty on an expiry of leave is considered as unauthorized absence.
If on any day(s) attendance has not been marked/leave or outdoor duty has not been applied for by the employee, such day(s) will be treated as a ‘Loss of Pay’ i.e., no salary for that day(s) will be paid.

Leave Policy:

Scope

This policy applies to all permanent employees within the company.

Philosophy
The leave policy is designed to meet the following:
To meet the diverse life stage needs to the employee.
To create a supportive environment and to enable employees to be more productive.
To make available time off from work
Leave Rules
Meridian Finance follows the calendar year for calculating leaves.
Leaves may be applied for in advance as per the existing leave policy of the Company.
Any unplanned leaves availed should be applied in the HR portal within 30 days of resuming duty, failing which the absence will be considered as leave without pay.
Leave Types
Fixed Holidays
Employees are granted 10 days of paid holidays in the calendar year, on occasion of National Holiday and Religious Festivals.
The list of these festival days in the calendar year is as decided by the company. The same is available on the the HR portal portal.
Path to check the same in the HR portal:
Attendance & Time off >> About me >> Holiday List

Privilege Leaves
For existing employees:

Privilege Leave (PL) is a type of leave that employees are entitled to as part of their employment benefits. It is a form of earned leave that allows employees to take time off from work for personal reasons, such as rest, relaxation, or attending to personal matters.
In a year, employees are granted a total of 25 PLs. These leaves are credited to their leave balance at the beginning of each month. Refer Annexure -1 for the month-wise leaves credits.
It's important to note that during the period of privileged leave, the weekly offs and holidays are not considered as leave days. This means that employees can enjoy their regular days off without it affecting their PL balance.
Employees have the flexibility to apply for PL for half a day or more, depending on their needs. However, it is expected that employees provide reasonable grounds for their leave request, ensuring that it aligns with the company's policies and guidelines.
To encourage employees to take time off and maintain a healthy work-life balance, it is mandatory for employees to utilize at least 15 PLs during the year. Any unused leaves within the mandatory requirement will lapse, meaning they cannot be carried forward to the next year.
Employees can accumulate a maximum of 30 PLs in a year. However, it's important to note that any PLs in excess of 30 days, after adjusting for the mandatory leave requirement, can be encashed. The encashment process takes place in the following year and is limited to a maximum of 10 days. Refer Annexure, 3 for illustrations on Leave balance treatments.
For New Hires
New employees will receive 20 Paid Leaves (PLs) during their first year of service. After the first year, the annual entitlement will increase to 25 days per service year.
PLs are credited at the beginning of each month. Refer Annexure, 2 for the month-wise leaves credits. After completing the first year, leave credits will follow the guidelines mentioned in clause 3.4.2 (I)(b).
It is important to note that any accrued leave until the end of the calendar year (December 31st) should be utilized. If not utilized, the leave will lapse, except for the prorated portion of 15 days out of the 25 days entitlement during the year. Refer Annexure, 3 for illustrations on Leave balance and carry forward treatments for the new hires.

Casual Leaves
This policy is applicable to the employees of Meridian Finance Ltd. as attached in detailed manner below in the Annexure 4 & Annexure 5.

Entitlements:

In a Calendar year, existing employees will be granted a total of 12 CLs. These leaves will be credited to their leave balance at the beginning of each month (one per month).
New joiners will receive prorated credit for the first month of joining and one leave per month for each subsequent month in the calendar year.

Guidelines on Casual Leaves:

Casual Leave (CL) is a flexible leave option provided to both existing and new hires, allowing them to take leave without having to provide a reason.
CL is an optional leave type, meaning employees can take it as needed. However, CL cannot be carried forward to the following year or encashed.
It is important to note that during the period of casual leave, the weekly offs and holidays are not considered as leave days. This means that employees can enjoy their regular days off without it affecting their CL balance.
Employees have the flexibility to apply for a half a day of CL depending on their needs
Employees may take upto as maximum of 3 CLs at a stretch / together within a given period of time.
It is important for the employees to note that they will have to apply for casual leaves in the the HR portal within 7 days from the day of availing the leaves.
CL balance cannot be used to offset the notice period.
The employees must obtain approval from the immediate superior while availing the Casual Leaves.
Employees may take PLs and CLs together subject to the maximum limits for each leave type.
Casual Leave will not be provided to employees as an advance.
Employees are not required to provide a reason for availing of their CLs; however, they are required to inform their immediate supervisor at least one day in advance

Exceptions

Any exceptions to this policy will require a written approval from the CHRO.

Special Day Leave

Employees are granted one day of leave either on occasion of their Birthday or their Anniversary.
This can be applied only on the date as specified in the the HR portal profile.
Special day leave cannot be converted into Privileged Leave. These leaves cannot be carried forward or encashed and hence will be lapsed if unutilized.

Maternity Leave

All female employees are eligible for twenty-six weeks of continuous paid maternity leave for first two surviving children. From third child onwards, the eligibility is of twelve weeks of continuous paid maternity leave.
The leaves are to be availed for a period extending up to 8 weeks (for first two children)/ 6 weeks (for third child onwards) before the expected delivery date and remaining weeks can be availed post childbirth.
The leaves can be extended by 14 more weeks in case required. This forms part of the childcare leave discussed ahead as mentioned in Clause 3.4.6.
The employees should inform the manager at least 15 days in advance before applying for Maternity Leave.
At the time of adoption, female employee is eligible for 12 weeks (84 days) of maternity leave. This is applicable for the first two children only.
In case of miscarriage or medical termination of pregnancy, if suggested by the doctor, the associate shall on production of such proof as may be prescribed, be entitled to leave with pay, for a period of 6 weeks immediately following the day of her miscarriage/medical termination of pregnancy.

Paternity Leave
The male employees are eligible for 5 days of paid paternity leave which can be taken in tranches within 6 months of the date of birth of the child. This is applicable only for first two children.
It can be availed at the time of adoption as well which should be consumed within six months of the date of adoption of the child. This is applicable only for first two adoption.

Childcare Leave
All permanent female employees with children of age less than 18 months shall be eligible to fourteen (14) weeks of paid Childcare Leave.
Childcare leave may be taken anytime for a minimum continuous period of one month and for as long as may be required till the child is a year and a half old.
This leave type is applicable for the first two children only.
Leave Encashment

Only the privileged leaves can be encashed.
At the time of encashment, if the prorated mandatory PLs have not been availed by the employee during the year, then such prorated PLs will be reduced before encashment.
The last drawn basic salary shall be applicable for encashment.
Leave Encashment in case of Notice Period

In case of involuntary exits, where notice period is waived off, leave encashment will be paid as per policy (no adjustments done)
Leave encashment is allowed only in January in the next calendar year.

For voluntary exits, leave encashment will be provided based on the following scenarios:
Notice period served: If an employee serves a complete notice period, then leave encashment will be appropriately pro-rated in line with the leave encashment rules. Please refer to Annexure 3 for detailed explanation with various scenarios.
Notice period not served/ Partially served:
If an employee is relieved early (as a part of management decision) & notice period is waived off, then leave encashment will be appropriately pro-rated in line with the leave encashment rules
If an employee is relieved early (as per employee request) & notice period is waived off, then leave encashment will be paid only after adjusting the number of days of leave available after the waived-off Notice period days.
Leave Rules in case of Resignation:
Employees may avail their accumulated leave from the previous years and prorated PL for the current year during the notice period on approval from their Immediate Supervisor.
The company will pay salary (Basic salary only) in lieu of number of days of PL outstanding (which will be calculated after deducting any unutilized mandatory prorated PL for the current year).
However, if resignation of the employee is before completion of 1 year of service, no PL will be due to him and no leave salary (i.e., Leave encashment) will be payable.

Unauthorized Absence/ Abandonment of Services/ Suspension:

Unauthorized Absence:

Failure to report to the transferred / designated location will be treated as unauthorized absence from duty.
Absence from duty without any prior approval of any type of leave or failure to report to duty on expiry of leave period will be treated as unauthorized absence.
In case of personal or family emergency for which employee is not able to apply for the leave, it is expected that a communication of his/ her absence is made to the immediate manager or HR Manager through a call/SMS/email. Failure of the same shall be deemed to be unauthorized leave, irrespective of the reason.

Abandonment

If unauthorized absence exceeds five working days, it will be treated as abandonment of services and the management will issue a warning letter to employee, asking them to return to duty.
The employee must present him / herself and offer an explanation for reason of absence within 72 hours from receipt of warning letter to avoid their name from being removed from the rolls of the Company.

Suspension

If an employee is under ‘Suspension’ for pending investigation on account of Process Violation, Cash Misappropriation, Fraud, BGV Red Case, Misbehavior, Sexual Harassment, or any other such disciplinary issue warranting financial loss or reputational damage to the company, then no salary would be paid to that employee during the period of Suspension.
Post completion of the investigation appropriate action will be taken accordingly.

Mandatory Leave Policy (Applicable to BL III & Above grades)

Introduction
Meridian Finance intends to introduce the concept of mandatory leave for the senior band employees (BLIII and above including GEC members,) to facilitate early alignment and transition management to the regulatory guidelines that are already in place for banks and may be brought into effect for the other sectors in the Financial Services domain as well.
Mandatory leave is also required to facilitate the concept of business continuity in the absence of key decision makers to strengthen the organizational machinery in trying times.

Policy Purpose
The purpose of this mandatory leave policy is to establish the policy tenets and procedures for taking mandatory leave for the eligible employees of Meridian Finance.

Policy Applicability
At present this policy will apply exclusively to all the Senior Management Employees including GEC members who are in grades BL III & above of Meridian Finance across all the registered legal entitles under the umbrella. For any new hires in the grades BLIII & above and any new entrants as an outcome of the promotion process the policy will apply only from the subsequent calendar year to which they are hired or promoted respectively.
If any of the following cases apply then eligible employees need not take mandatory leave separately during that calendar year, Medical leave for a minimum of 05 (FIVE) consecutive working days
Maternity Leave, out of the total maternity leave at least 10 (TEN) consecutive calendar days should be in that calendar year to enable the exemption for that calendar year
Paternity Leave which has been taken at a single stretch within a calendar year
Long leave for personal reasons for a minimum of 05 (FIVE) consecutive working days.

Policy Overview
All GEC members and senior band employees in grades BLIII and above are required to take mandatory leave once in a calendar year. When taking said leave the following tenets must be adhered to -
Mandatory Leave should not exceed 10 (TEN) consecutive calendar days
Minimum of 05 (FIVE) consecutive working days must be covered during the period of 10 (TEN) calendar days
Mandatory leave is to be taken in a single stretch falling within the same calendar year
Employees are free to club the following when applying for Mandatory Leave,
CL
PL
Weekly Off
Pubic Holiday
The following work arrangements DO NOT apply when on Mandatory Leave, Work From Anywhere
OD
Mandatory leave must be planned and discussed with the immediate supervisor at least 01 (ONE) month in advance
Mandatory leave must be applied for and also approved by the immediate supervisor in the system 15 (FIFTEEN) days in advance
Delegation of authority to relevant team members must be signed off and communicated to all relevant stakeholders at least 05 (FIVE) working days in advance
Decision making to be delegated to the relevant team members and must be signed off and communicated to all the relevant stakeholders at least 05 (FIVE) working days in advance
Ongoing specific tasks / projects need to assigned to relevant team members as needed and last status to be signed off with the immediate supervisor prior to going on leave.

Rules of Conduct during Mandatory Leave
Eligible employees are required to adhere to the following rules of conduct during their Mandatory Leave, Should not access any physical or virtual resources related to their work responsibilities
Should ensure that the team is adequately equipped to manage day to day approvals and decision making
Should have access to internal/ corporate email which is usually available to all employees for general purposes but should not utilize the channel to provide approvals / decision making unless mandated to do so by exception by the immediate supervisor
Should redirect work calls to the relevant people while they are on leave
Should sensitize their external vendors / stakeholders on their leave of absence and redirect them to the relevant people
Should set an out of office auto reply for their email that calls out who are the relevant people that the sender can get in touch with during their leave of absence

Cancellation of Mandatory Leave
It is the immediate supervisor’s responsibility to ensure that the employee is not forced to cancel their Mandatory Leave owing to any work exigency.
In the event that cancellation is absolutely unavoidable then the immediate supervisor will need to get an approval from the CHRO and MD&CEO to reimburse the employee for losses pertaining to cancellation charges of travel tickets / hotel bookings / etc subject to provision of relevant supporting documents to validate the claim.
Employees voluntarily cancelling their pre-planned Mandatory Leave are not eligible for any compensation towards cancellations etc.

Penalty for Non-Compliance to the Mandatory Leave policy
Non-Compliance to the mandatory leave policy will result in 5 PLs being deducted from the carry forward balance of the respective employee.
If the employee has already reached the limit of maximum carry forward then the management reserves the right to deduct 05 (FIVE) PLs from the encashable PL balance / maximum carry forward PL balance or any combination therein as they may deem fit.
Extension of Mandatory Leave
An employee may choose to take a leave of longer duration than is mandated and may by all means do so subject to the following conditions, Availability of relevant leave balance
Prior approval of the immediate supervisor
Prior intimation to the relevant stakeholders about their non availability during the period
Prior agreement with their immediate supervisor on delegation of authority
Clear understanding and agreement with the immediate supervisor on which period falls under the mandatory leave and which falls under the additional discretionary leave
Deviation
Any deviations to the policy will require the CHRO’s written approval.

Work-from-Anywhere
Objective
The objective of the Work from Anywhere (WFA) policy is,
To allow employees the freedom to choose their work environment for a defined period of time. This flexibility will enable employees to better manage their personal commitments and responsibilities.
To enable employees to be more productive and focused when working in an environment of their choice, such as their home.
The Work from Anywhere policy may also be extended to serve as a contingency plan during unforeseen circumstances, such as natural disasters, public health emergencies or pandemics.
In such instances where the policy is expected to serve as a contingency plan the Meridian Finance management will communicate the relevant changes enabling extension of the same at the appropriate time.

Scope & Applicability
This policy is applicable to the employees of Meridian Finance Ltd. as attached in detailed manner in the Annexure 4 & Annexure 5.

Entitlements
Subject to applicability as detailed in the Annexure 4 & Annexure 5, the entitlements are as below:

Employees can avail upto 5 days as a Work-from-anywhere (WFA) in a calendar year.
Employees can avail a minimum of 1 day of Work-from-anywhere.
All existing employees will receive a credit of 5 days of Work-from-anywhere in the month of January.
All New Joiners will also receive a credit of 5 days of Work-from-anywhere in the month of their joining.
Any unused days of Work-from- anywhere will automatically lapse at the end of the Calendar Year and not get carried forward.
Additionally, employees can opt for WFA on 1st Working Saturdays ONLY with mandatory prior approval of their immediate supervisor in the HR portal
Under no circumstances will employees be allowed to opt for 4th and 5th Working Saturday as a work from anywhere, Employees must mandatorily work from their office locations.

Guidelines on Work-from-Anywhere

For existing employees, five days as Work-from-anywhere will be credited in the month of January each year and for new joiners it will be credited in the month of joining.
Employees have the option to avail WFA for a minimum of 1 day and a maximum of 5 days within the calendar year.
It is mandatory for the employees to seek approval from their Immediate Supervisor at least one day in advance while requesting for WFA.
It is important for the employees to note that they will have to mandatorily apply and ensure their immediate supervisor’s approval for WFA in the HR portal prior to the start of their WFA.
Employees are allowed to avail of Work from anywhere even from a location that is not their base location. This is subject to the caveat that any travel related costs will be the personal expense of the employee and that the organization will in no way be liable to cover any costs associated with such travel.
Employees are responsible for ensuring their availability during their shift timings on days when they opt to work from home. Any time zone differences must be taken into account by the employee.
WFA days will automatically lapse and not get carried forward on 31st Dec each year.
WFA is not permitted under any circumstances on the fourth and fifth Saturdays of the month.

Work-from-Anywhere Protocols

Employees opting for Work from Anywhere will be required to keep the following guidelines in mind:

Communicate proactively with your manager and team and keep them informed about tasks, deliverables and availability.
Ensure that you are in a safe environment with appropriate network connectivity.
Avoid working from public spaces such as coffee shops, restaurants, etc.
In case of any unavoidable circumstances where you are required to work in public space ensure that your device is not discoverable on the WI-FI network and use a screen shield wherever feasible.
Stay connected and participate in virtual meetings as and when required.
Follow company policies during remote work including security protocols and communication channels.
Ensure that the cybersecurity measures are adhered to and that sensitive company information and data are appropriately handled while working remotely.
Ensure that you follow the appropriate dress code guidelines when attending meetings virtually.
Maintain professionalism in all virtual interactions, meetings and communications.
Ensure that your device/s are protected and stored correctly when not in use.
Immediate supervisor will be required to ensure that the employee who is working remotely adheres to the shift timings and is connected and engaged.

Exceptions

Any exceptions to this policy will require a written approval from the CHRO.

Entitlements
The entitlements for WFA for all eligible employees are as below:

Employees can avail a maximum of one day as a WFA per Calendar Week.
Employees can avail a minimum of one day of Work-from-anywhere per Calendar Week. Half a day of WFA is not permitted.
There will be no carry forward of WFA from one week to the next
WFA of one day will become available on every Sunday and will automatically lapse on Friday end of day.

Sandwich Leave
Where an employee takes leave on the working day immediately before and the working day immediately after a holiday or a weekly off, the intervening holiday or weekly off will also be counted as leave. For example, if an employee is on leave on the Friday before a weekend and on the Monday after it, the Saturday and Sunday in between are also treated as leave, and a total of four days of leave is deducted. This rule applies to Privilege Leave and Casual Leave. It does not apply where the employee is on leave on only one side of the holiday or weekly off. Employees are encouraged to plan leave around holidays and weekly offs keeping this provision in mind.

Any questions and suggestions on the implementation of the policy should be directed to the ‘Authorized Personnel’ as mentioned in the Clause 1.2.1.

For the purpose of this document, the term ‘company’ would refer to Meridian Finance & all registered legal entities under the umbrella.

Please note that this policy version shall supersede all earlier versions. Meridian Finance will endeavour to update this policy as required. Notwithstanding, Meridian Finance will follow the prevailing statutory requirements at the point of any application / notification.

INTRODUCTION

Business travel is an important and necessary expense to the company. Travel on behalf of the company should not result in a cost to the employee, nor should it result in a profit. Just as personal expenses are monitored, the same care should be given to corporate travel costs. In the interest of fairness and uniform treatment of employees, the company has embraced the following policy. This document establishes procedures for employees of Meridian Finance.
All travel will be monitored and compliance with this policy will be enforced. Employees who do not comply with this travel policy may be subject to delay or withholding of reimbursement and/or disciplinary action up to and including termination.

1.1 Policy Objective

The overall objectives of the travel and business expense policy are to:
Provide guidelines and procedures to facilitate employees travelling for business purpose.
Eliminate unnecessary and discretionary travel.
Ensure that all employees have a clear and consistent understanding of policies and procedures for when and how business travel is conducted.
Maximize the company’s ability to negotiate discounted rates with preferred suppliers and reduce travel expenses.
Provide business travel employees with satisfactory level of service and comfort at the lowest possible cost.

The policy must be adhered to when planning and conducting local, domestic and international business travel and when submitting travel and business expense reports.

All travel must be limited to business requirements only. It is the responsibility of each employee and business unit to determine the extent to which travel for company business and internal meetings is required, and whether such events can be conducted via more cost-effective means.

1.2 Policy Management

1.2.1 Policy Application and Interpretation

This policy will be in effect from _________. The terms and conditions contained herein must be adhered to when making an agreement between the Company and the business traveller in relation to travel for business purpose, as long as they are compatible with national legislation.

The Company’s Compensation & Benefits Team and FCM Team will resolve any questions regarding the interpretation and application of this policy. Any exceptions to the Policy will require CHRO’s written approval.

1.2.2 Policy Amendments and Updates
The Company reserves the right to amend this policy at any time. When and where a change in this policy is made the company undertakes to notify the employees as soon as feasible.

1.3 Responsibilities, Compliance

The individual traveler is responsible for complying with the travel policy.
The traveler’s manager is responsible to ensure that reportee’s travel is only for business requirement.
The accounts department is responsible for accurately reviewing expenses report submitted by the travelers at the time claims settlement.
The company is responsible for reimbursing employees for all reasonable and necessary expenses while traveling on authorized company business. The company assumes no obligation to reimburse employees for expenses that are not in compliance with this policy.

LOCAL BUSINESS TRAVEL

Scope

This benefit is extended to all employees who are traveling within 100km(one-way) from the workplace for business purposes within the same city.

Eligibility

All permanent employees in grades FL III & above are eligible to claim reimbursement for local travel made for official travel/client visit/ branch visit/ training.
Female employees who leave office post 9:00 PM and Male employees who leave office post 10:00 PM are eligible to claim reimbursement from the place of work to their residence within the eligibility grid basis the approval from their Immediate Supervisor.

Exclusion

Employees who have availed of Company Owned Car Scheme (COCS) or Employee-Owned Car Scheme (EOCS) are not eligible to avail this policy.
Employees who receive local conveyance as a part of their incentives which is paid through salary are not eligible to claim local reimbursement.
Reimbursement shall not be given for travel from Residence to Office / Place of work and return.
Reimbursement shall not be given for any expense incurred on buying a Local railway / Metro / Bus, monthly / quarterly / half yearly pass.

Entitlement

Employees may use a mode of travel such as Metered Taxi, Radio Taxis (Uber/Ola), Auto, Train or Bus depending on eligibility as per their grade.
Employees may also use their own vehicle (Four-Wheeler/Two-Wheeler) and get the fuel reimbursement depending on eligibility as per their grade.
All such travels are to be approved by the immediate supervisor.
Reimbursement will be claimed only through the HR portal under Expenses Management Module. Please refer Annexure-1 for grade-wise reimbursement entitlement Pan India.
Exception: For few of the travel intensive roles, the monthly entitlement reimbursement limits have been defined based on the Business Unit. Please refer Annexure-2 for the detail entitlement Pan India.
For employees based out of Mumbai, Delhi, Bangalore & Kolkata in few specific Business Unit, the monthly limit would be INR 6,500. Please refer Annexure, 3 for the detail.
Employees can refer to the the HR portal: Expense Management: Local Travel in the Knowledge Base Section of the HR portal to understand the eligibility and entitlement for Local Business Travel.
Alternatively, employees can also connect with their MY HR CONTACT (BHR) for any clarification with regards to any queries related to raising the claims.
Please refer the user manual in Annexure 10, which provides a detailed description of the process to be followed during local business travel.

Settlement of Claims

All travel expense claims should be submitted within 60 days from the date of travelling on the HR portal.
Only Two request per month can be claimed.
Maximum eligibility prescribed in the policy is the upper cap for the month for all kinds of bills inclusive of public transport and use of own vehicle.
Employees may refer to the User Manual provided in the Knowledge Base Section of the HR portal to understand the process to be followed for settling the travel claims for Local Business Travel.
Alternatively, employees can also connect with their MY HR CONTACT(BHR) for any clarification with regards to settling the claims.
Exception:
Exceptions in the policy will require approval by a BL grade employee, Zonal Manager or National Manager as applicable in the employee’s hierarchy.
In cases where the amount claimed more than eligibility limit, supporting proofs are to be provided.
Local conveyance for FL IV (exceptions to be approved by a BL level person in the employee's hierarchy)
Please refer the user manual in Annexure 10, which provides a detailed description of the process to be settling claims for local business travel.

Domestic Outstation Travel:

Scope

This benefit is extended to all employees who are traveling 100km (one-way) or more from the workplace for business purposes.

Eligibility
All permanent employees as per their eligibility on the basis grade, on nature of business requirement may be required to travel outside the city.
Exception
Any expenditure in the form of entertainment shall fall outside the purview of this policy and shall not be reimbursed.
Pre-Travel Requirements

Travel approval Procedure:
Employee needs to prepare a travel plan and take IS (Immediate Supervisor’s) approval.
Retainers will require BL level approval within the reporting hierarchy for outstation travel.
Travel Booking Procedure:
Employees need to raise travel request in the HR portal.
Air Tickets: Request should be raised at least 7 Working days in advance from the date of travel.
Rail Tickets: Request should be raised at least 15 days in advance from the date of travel.
Personal/Own Vehicle: Employees can also use their own vehicle for such travel types and they shall be provided with fuel reimbursements as per eligibility.
OL I and below cadre employees are requested to share email request from BL level to enable Tab for Car Hire during his/her Domestic Business Travel
If an Employee wants to claim his / her travel expenses like Conveyance and food expenses, then he/she needs to obtain a the HR portal request approved first from his IS. If the Travel date is within 7 working days, then need approval from respective GEC members. In case of No claim, he/she can go directly to the travel desk app for Travel bookings.

On receipt of the request, FCM team will process the request and arrange for the ticket, boarding and lodging as per eligibility prescribed in the policy.
Email Id in case of any queries: adminsupport@meridianfinance.com
All employees must book their air travel through FCM team itself; no reimbursement of airfare tickets will be approved. Employee can make his/her own arrangements for other modes of transport, boarding or lodging only if FCM team is unable to make the same and has confirmed/updated the same through travel request raised in the HR portal (in situations like absence of FCM corporate tie-up in interior locations or any other situation). Offline confirmations shall stand invalid and such expenses shall not be reimbursed.
In order to get more detail on pre-booking procedure, employees may refer to the User Manual of Travel Management found in the HR portal. Alternatively, employees can also connect with their MY HR CONTACT (BHR).
Please refer the user manual in Annexure 9, which provides a detailed description of the process to be followed during domestic outstation travel.
Employees can also make the travel bookings using the the travel desk Application. Please refer Annexure 11 for the the travel desk application User manual and Annexure 12 for the FAQs.

Entitlements for Travel

Employees may use a mode of travel such as Flight, Train, Personal Vehicle and Bus, depending on eligibility as per their grade/role.
Tickets will be arranged by the central travel department or the local administrative set up which shall take into consideration convenience, comfort and cost optimization while booking the tickets.
Use of own vehicle has daily travel distance limit and monthly claim amount limit.
Please refer Annexure, 4 (Table A) for the Travel Entitlements for Domestic Travels.
Approval Matrix for Using Own Vehicle:
OL I & Above roles require immediate supervisor approval for using their own vehicle.
OL II & Below roles require BL level approval in their respective hierarchy for using their own vehicle.
For the roles mentioned in Annexure, 4 (Table B), approval can be provided by the immediate Supervisor.

Accommodation

During outstation travel, which is for more than 24 hours, employee shall be supported with accommodation in serviced apartments empaneled by the Company. If Serviced apartments are not available in that destination, then the FCM team will arrange for accommodation in hotel.
The company reserves all the rights to do/modify the booking as per availability and cost. Please refer the table in Annexure, 5 where the accommodation limits are defined.
Entitlement of Per Diem in Lieu of Hotel Accommodation:
Employees are entitled to receive Per Diem (as detailed in Annexure 7 below) basis declaration of Own Stay Arrangements.
Valid Travel Request needs to be raised in the the HR portal and the same needs to be approved by his/her Immediate Supervisor.
Employee will need to upload declaration in the preset format (as detailed in Annexure 13 below).
If they choose this option the Employee will still be eligible to claim meal reimbursements as per their grade limit with supporting bills as detailed in Annexure 6 below.

Daily Reimbursement

During Outstation travel, the employee shall be eligible for reimbursement of daily meal expenses as per the defined eligibility for their grade.
Meal expenses shall not include the cost of liquor or alcoholic beverages, if any.
Local travel at the destination location shall be reimbursed within reasonable limits and the employee should provide relevant supporting documents towards the same. If the employee is utilizing their own vehicle for outstation travel, then no separate claims towards local travel at that destination will be reimbursed.

City Category

The reimbursement limits defined for domestic out-station travels are categorized as per city categorization provided below:

Category ‘A+’ - Mumbai, Delhi, Kolkata, Chennai, Bangalore and Hyderabad.
Category ‘A’, Includes the following cities: Chandigarh, Ahmedabad, Gurgaon (NCR), Guwahati, Indore, Jaipur, Pune & Udaipur
Category ‘B’ , Agra, Bhopal, Bhubaneswar, Cochin, Coimbatore, Jalandhar, Lucknow, Ludhiana, Madurai, Mangalore, Nagpur, Ranchi, Trichy, Trivandrum, Vijayawada, Patna, Vizag, Varanasi, Ayodhya, Raipur, Vadodara and Surat.
Category ‘C’ - Cities excluded from Category ‘A+, A’ & Category ‘B’
Settlement of Claims

All travel expenses may be claimed separately in the HR portal under travel request within 60 days of travel.
All expenses incurred on self during the outstation travel would be reimbursed as per eligibility.
All original documents need to be submitted along with the expense settlement request.
Exceptions:
Exceptions in this will require approval by a BL grade employee, Zonal Manager or National Manager as applicable in the employee’s hierarchy.
Travel request for booking air tickets within 4 working days or less prior to the date of journey would require approval from respective GEC member.
Expenses incurred in excess of eligibility as prescribed in the policy (Annexure, 4 and 5) will require approval as mentioned below:
Expenses exceeding upto 20% of eligibility can be approved by BL and above employee within the reporting hierarchy*
Expenses more than 20% of eligibility will require approval from respective Group of Executive Committee (GEC) member*
Exception is not applicable for exhausting monthly claim amount limit & distance travelled per day for Own vehicle travel.
Please refer the user manual in Annexure 9, which provides a detailed description of the process to be settling claims for domestic outstation travel.

International Travel:

Scope and Eligibility:
This policy applies to all permanent employees in grades FL III and above, who are required to travel internationally for business purposes.

Pre-Travel Requirements

Travel approval Procedure:
All International travels are to be approved by the Managing Director and CEO (MD and CEO).
Travel Booking Procedure:
Employees are expected to submit the requisition at least 10 days in advance.
After the approval from the MD, authorized requisition has to be forwarded to the FCM department for processing the travel request.
All travel related processing, including air ticket, hotel booking, visa formalities are arranged by FCM team.
Employees are covered under the International Travel Insurance.

Immigration (Passports, Business Visas)

Passport
Employees are expected to have valid passport with minimum 6 months validity at all times. Expenses on passport and its renewal are the responsibility of the employee and shall not be reimbursed.

Visa
Employee must apply for the correct type of visa for travel- Business or Work, based on the purpose of traveMeridianhe country/s for which travel is intended. The company will bear cost of visa and other incidental charges including Airport tax, exit tax or any other taxes relating to the visit.

Foreign Exchange

All employees travelling overseas are eligible for advance in foreign exchange in form travelers’ card or cash or both. Request for foreign currency has to be made to Accounts department 5 days in advance.

On-ground Transport and Local Conveyance

Once the employee has reached the destination by flight or taxi, employee may need to travel to a vendor or client for business meetings. In such situations it is recommended for the employee to use hotel shuttle, book taxis or use the public transportation as suitable.
The local conveyance limits for international travel as per Country Category is provided in Annexure 8.

Accommodation

It is recommended to make hotel reservations through the FCM department for international travel. However, employees also have the option to make their own hotel reservations.
The limits on Accommodation for international travel as per Country Category is provided in Annexure 8.

Meals

Meal expenses while traveling for business purpose, shall be reimbursed as per below Annexure 8. Limits are defined considering three meals a day for a business traveler.

Country Category

The reimbursement limits defined for international travels are categorized as per country categorization is provided below:
Category ‘A’ - Europe, USA, Canada, Japan, Australia, Switzerland
Category ‘B’, Dubai, Singapore, Hong Kong, Malaysia, China, Taiwan
Category ‘C’, All other countries not covered in "A" & "B."

Our goal is to ensure that international business travel is conducted smoothly and that employees are clear about their responsibilities and entitlements. If employees have any questions or require further clarification, please contact MY HR CONTACT (BHR).

the travel desk Application, FAQs

Q1. Employee can download the travel desk app on his/her Mobile?
A. Yes, Employee can download the travel desk for business App (Available on both IOS and Android)

Q2. Employee can use this facility for his/her personal ticket booking?
A. No, this App is applicable only for Official Business Tour only

Q3. Which facilities, Employee can avail with this Travel App?
A. Employee can book his/her Flight ticket and Hotel booking pertaining Business travel

Q4. Employee need to raise the HR portal request before processing bookings on the travel desk App?
A. If Employee want to claim his / her travel expenses like Conveyance and food expenses, then he/she need to obtain the HR portal request first from his IS. If Travel date is within 4 working days, then he/she need approval from respective GEC member. In case of No claim, Employee can process his/her bookings directly through the travel desk App

Q5. Can Employee Block Multiple Tickets for the same sector?
A. No, the same is not advisable and correct. Respective Airlines may reject / remove both the PNRs any time before departure.

Q6. Hotel Bookings Terms for Booking through the travel desk App
A. Only Stay and Breakfast will be Bill to Company

Q7. What do we select during Air Bookings?
A. Employee need to select Corporate Rate always during Flight booking. In absence of Corporate rate in any particular sector, Employee can select Regular / Published rate. Please note, Employee need to select Lower rate within the mentioned Time Slot always

Q8. What is the meaning of “OUT OF POLICY” in case of Flight bookings?
A. If the travel date is within 4 working days of the booking date

Q9. What is the meaning of “OUT OF POLICY” in case of Hotel Bookings?
A. If the travel date is within 4 working days of the booking date or the booking amount is beyond the limits mentioned as per Meridian Finance Domestic Travel policy.

Q10. What is the meaning of Missed Savings?
A. In case, Employee haven’t chosen the lowest price flight as per his/her departure time, system will prompt a miss saving pop up and show you other lower flight option available within the same time frame.

Q11. Can Employee select his/her Meal options and Seat options during Booking?
A. Yes, Employee can select available free seats during booking

Q12. In case of any Modification / cancellation of any Bookings before Travel date
Please contact your local FCM Travel Manager OR please refer the travel desk User Guide

Q13. Can Employee book Bus / Train tickets in the travel desk
Yes, Employees can book Bus/Train Tickets from the travel desk Portal.

Q14. I have not received a Confirmation Mail after submission of Request, whom should I contact.
A. Please get in touch with Customer Care Support Team.

Q15. If I cancel My Travel Request in the HR portal will my Flight / Hotel bookings in the travel desk will be cancelled automatically? or should I cancel in the travel desk Portal Separately.
A. If the travel is cancelled, Employee needs to cancel the Flight/Hotel booking from the travel desk Portal.

Q16. While Raising a Travel Request in the HR portal for Hotels I have selected "Own Arrangement" but later I decided to book a Hotel through the travel desk. Should I need to modify my Travel Request?
A. Yes. Employee needs to modify the request in the HR portal also.

Q17. Will the Ticket requests raised in the travel desk get submitted to Immediate Superior for approval?
A. Yes, Once the request is submitted in the travel desk Portal it will go to IS for approval. If Travel date is within 4 working days, then it will go for GEC approval.

Q18. What are the working Hours of the travel desk Customer Care. Helpdesk / Customer Care number and E-Mail IDs of the travel desk team"

A. Please get in touch with Customer Care Support Team.

Q20. Can Employee Book Outstation Cab from the travel desk Portal?
A. No, Employees need to raise a travel request in the HR portal for cab booking and follow the Existing Process for Booking an Outstation Cab.

The compensation philosophy of a company is a set of guiding principles and beliefs that shape how the organization approaches and manages employee compensation. It serves as a framework for making decisions about salary, bonuses, benefits, and other forms of compensation Policy.

Any questions and suggestions on the implementation of the policy should be directed to the ‘Authorized Personnel’ as mentioned in the Clause 1.2.1.

For the purpose of this document, the term ‘company’ would refer to Meridian Finance & all registered legal entities under the umbrella.

Please note that all policies and processes stipulated in this version shall supersede those set out in any earlier versions of the HR manual. Meridian Finance will endeavour to update this policy as required.

INTRODUCTION

Total rewards and compensation benefits are an essential part of any employer-employee relationship. They can help to attract, retain, and motivate employees, and can also have a positive impact on productivity, engagement, and morale.

1.1 Policy Objective

The overall objectives of the policy are:

This policy ensures that the company's compensation practices align with industry standards and meet the expectations of potential employees.
A compensation philosophy ensures internal equity by establishing a consistent and fair approach to compensation across the organization.
A well-defined compensation philosophy aligns with the overall goals and values of the organization. It supports the company's strategic objectives by incentivizing behaviours and outcomes that contribute to its success.

1.2 Policy Management

1.2.1 Policy Application and Interpretation

This policy will be in effect from _________.

The Company’s Compensation & Benefits Team will resolve any questions regarding the interpretation and application of this policy. Any exceptions to the Policy will require CHRO’s written approval.

1.2.2 Policy Amendments and Updates
The Company reserves the right to amend this policy at any time. When and where a change in this policy is made the company undertakes to notify the employees as soon as feasible.

1.3 Scope
This policy is applicable to all the permanent employees who are on the rolls of Meridian Finance.

1.4 Responsibilities and Compliance

The Company need to clearly define the objectives of the Compensation Philosophy policy. This includes determining the desired position of the organization in the market, the level of competitiveness, and the overall compensation.
The Company should effectively communicate the Compensation Philosophy policy to all employees.
The Company have a responsibility to comply with all applicable laws and regulations related to compensation.
Employees have a responsibility to adhere to all company policies and regulations related to compensation. This includes following guidelines for timekeeping, attendance, and any other policies that may impact compensation.

Compensation Administration
Salary is paid on the 24th of every month. If 24th is holiday, salary will be paid on preceding working day.
Employee needs to update their Bank account number and PAN details in SSC portal. Failure of this may lead to non-payment of salary.
The salary components are as per the appointment letter of the employee, unless otherwise informed by the HR Manager via official mail or revised Salary breakup letter.

Components

Total rewards and compensation benefits comprises of Fixed Pay and the Variable Pay and Retirals.

Fixed Pay: This comprises of the Basic Salary and the flexible Benefits. The flexible benefits provide employees with the flexibility to choose how they allocate a portion of their total compensation package. Refer Clause 4 for more detail on the Flexible Benefits.
Variable Pay: This is a performance-based pay. This provides employees with the opportunity to earn additional compensation based on their individual or team performance. Unlike fixed pay, which is a predetermined and fixed amount, variable pay is contingent upon achieving specific performance goals or targets.
Retirals: This includes benefits like Provident Fund and Gratuity, providing financial security to employees upon retirement or separation from employment, ensuring a stable post-work life. These schemes, mandated by law, offer employees a means to accumulate savings and receive lump sum payments or pensions based on their years of service.
Please refer Annexure, 1 to understand the grade-wise Fixed and Variable ratio.

Option for Flexible Benefits in Salary Structure

Purpose

Objective is to facilitate higher disposable income in the hands of the employees and promote retirement savings through a tax friendly salary structure.

Eligibility

This plan is applicable only to FL III and above; since employees at FL IV grade are at salary levels which are lower than the minimum taxable salary as applicable under the Income Tax Act.

Salient Features

The benefits to be introduced to employees to avail maximum tax benefits are as follows:

3.3.1. National Pension Scheme

National Pension Scheme (NPS) is an easily accessible, low cost, tax-efficient, flexible and portable retirement savings account. Under NPS, an individual contributes to his retirement account.

Maximum Limit: - An Employees can contribute 10% of their basic salary through Company. Please note that the contribution of up to 10% of basic salary is exempt from Income Tax u/s 80CCD (2) of the Income Tax Act.

Withdrawal options and Tax Treatment
Withdrawal options and Tax Treatment on the withdrawal is as mentioned in the below table:

Particulars
| Pre-Mature - Exit
| Exit on Maturity
|
Eligibility
| Employees can exit from the scheme after 10 years of account opening
| Employees can exit from the scheme on attainment of retirement age
|
Withdrawal and Tax Exemption
| Upto 20% of the corpus in lump sum can be withdrawn. The remainder, i.e., 80% of the corpus will be utilized for purchasing Annuity from a life insurance company.
Corpus withdrawn in lump sum is tax exempt.
If Corpus is < Rs.1 lacs, it can be withdrawn entirely
| Upto 60% of the corpus in lump sum can be withdrawn. The remainder, i.e., 40% of the corpus will be utilized for purchasing Annuity from a life insurance company.
40% of the Corpus withdrawn in lump sum is tax exempt; Employee can take out balance 20% of the corpus by paying tax (if falling into tax bracket) or invest in Annuity.
If Corpus is < Rs.2 lacs, it can be withdrawn entirely
|
Tax treatment on Annuity
| Pension received is treated as income and will be taxed as per the tax bracket
|

Charges

8586931242000The following charges will be borne by participating employees:

3.3.2 Food Coupons

Employees can opt for Food Coupons through Flexi Benefit program from the salary. These Food Coupons must be utilized for purchase of meal or grocery item.

Maximum Limits: Annual benefit of INR 24,000. INR 50 per meal is exempt from Income Tax under Section 17 (2) as per the number of meals defined by the company.

The employees can avail one out of the following two options:
INR 1,000 per month
INR 2,000 per month

Charges

No cost for employees while opting for these schemes; An amount of Rs.100 would be charged to the employee only in case of loss / replacement of physical Sodexo card for Food Coupons.

3.3.3 Fuel and Drivers Salary Reimbursement on Employee Owned Car

Income tax provisions allow benefit of Fuel and Driver’s Salary Reimbursement on employee-owned cars when the car is utilized for both private and official purposes.

Maximum Limits
Annual benefits in the range of INR 21,600 to INR 39,600 basis selection from employee is exempt from Income Tax:

Component
| Car upto 1600 cc
| Car above 1600 cc
|
Fuel Reimbursement*
| INR 21,600 per annum
| INR 28,800 per annum
|
Driver’s Salary
| INR 10,800 per annum
| INR 10,800 per annum
|
Total
| INR 32,400 per annum
| INR 39,600 per annum
|
* Only applicable for Petrol and Diesel

Guidelines to opt for these benefits:

Common Guidelines

The interested employees are required to log on to SSC the employee portal and submit the Flexible Benefits form online with all the required details for one or more of the following options:

1. NPS
2. Food Coupons
3. Fuel & Driver Salary reimbursement

The process to opt for these benefits is attached as Annexure 2.

Amount under all the identified heads will be carved out from Special allowance and will be treated in the following manner:

NPS: Employer’s contribution will be directly remitted in their respective PRAN account.
Food Coupons: The equivalent amount (as selected by the employee) will be credited into Food card.
Fuel & Driver Salary reimbursement: The equivalent amount (as selected by the employee) will be credited in the physical card.

Option to Change or Opt Out: Employee can opt out only once in a year by changing the flexible components option on SSC; the window for this will be open only from 1st April to 15th April every year and the changes will be effective from April payroll.

New employees:
For new employees the link will be active for 1 month from Date of joining on SSC the employee portal rest remains same as stated above for existing employees.

Guidelines for NPS

Employees will have to apply for PRAN account number as mentioned in Annexure 2.
On receipt of PRAN account number, employees will have to update the PRAN account no on SSC the employee portal
Post updating PRAN account number, SSC will start deducting the NPS contributions from next month.
Contributions so deducted will be remitted to employees NPS account which will be visible online or through mobile app.
SSC along with the identified NPS service provider will be responsible for administering the NPS contribution.
In order to keep the NPS account active, a minimum contribution of INR 500 is mandatory.

Guidelines for Food Coupons

For smooth utilization of Food Coupons our partner will issue physical plastic cards as well as digital card, which can be swiped and utilized for purchase of only food and grocery bills; these cards will be issued to the registered employees only.
The dispatch address needs to be updated on SSC as mentioned in ANNEXURE I for delivery of the physical card for food coupons; in case the employee changes his address, it needs to be updated on the SSC portal.
Amount of INR 1000 or 2000 as per the options selected by employees will be deducted from employee’s salary through payroll and amount so deducted will be loaded in employees Food card. Employees can use this amount for purchase of food and grocery items.
Detailed process flow is provided as Annexure 2
A fresh card will be issued to the new entrants free of cost but replacement for loss of these cards will be chargeable as per the charges mentioned in the charges section above.

Guidelines for Fuel and Driver Salary Reimbursement

Employee will have to fill a declaration form that he/she has a car and will be required to submit his/ her car and driver details for getting the benefit for Fuel & Driver Salary Reimbursement respectively on SSC portal.
Our partner will then issue physical as well as digital card to registered employees and carry on required KYC.
Amount as per the options selected by employees will be deducted from employee’s salary through payroll and amount so deducted will be loaded in employees Fuel card. Employees can use this amount for Fuel consumption directly either through swiping the card or through mobile app. Employees can also go for reimbursement if the amount if the amount is paid by them.
Detailed process flow is provided as Annexure 2.
A fresh card will be issued to the new entrants free of cost.

Retirals
There are a number of statutory benefits that Indian employers are required to provide to their employees. These include:

Provident fund: Employers and employees are required to contribute a certain percentage of their salary to the Employees' Provident Fund (EPF). The EPF is a retirement savings scheme that provides employees with a lump sum payment upon retirement.
Employees' State Insurance (ESI): Employers are required to register their employees with the Employees' State Insurance Corporation (ESIC) and pay ESI contributions on their behalf. ESI provides employees with medical benefits, such as hospitalization, maternity leave, and sickness benefits.
Gratuity: Employees who have worked for a company for more than five years are entitled to gratuity upon retirement or termination of employment. Gratuity is a lump sum payment that is calculated based on the employee's salary and years of service.

Other Benefits
Matching Grant Scheme (MGS):
Overview and Eligibility

The Matching Grant Scheme (MGS) is a unique plan designed for Meridian employees.

Employees will be eligible to enrol for the MGS from Date of Joining. Employer will match the contribution from first day of SIP, however, employee will be eligible for employer’s contribution and returns thereon, only after securing a rating of 3 and above in his/her first appraisal cycle.

Eligibility and Contribution

For all eligible employees who invest in any of the prescribed HSBC Mutual Fund schemes, the respective employer will match the employee’s monthly investments up to a maximum of Rs. 4,000 per month for a period of 48 months. Your contribution will be deducted through payroll and the units that are purchased from your contribution will be held in an HSBC Mutual Fund folio (account) in your name. The units that are purchased from the employer’s contribution will be held in a Trust folio (account) for your benefit and on completion of 4 years (48 months) from the date of your first investment you will be eligible to receive the units that were purchased from the employer’s contribution.

Illustration

Suppose an employee choose to invest Rs. 4,000 per month, we will also invest Rs. 4,000 for your benefit to make it a total monthly contribution of Rs. 8,000.
Over the course of the Scheme, your total contribution would work out to Rs. 1,92,000. Combine this with our match of the same amount, and assuming an average growth of 8% a year*, the total benefit to you at the end of 48 months would be over Rs. 4,50,000.

The growth rate of 8% p.a. monthly compounding is just indicative in nature.
For any queries, please write us at helpdesk@meridianfinance.com

Please refer Annexure, 4 for the FAQs on MGS.

Mobile Reimbursement
This is applicable only when employees have postpaid bill.
The eligibility amount depends on the grade of the employee.
The benefit can be availed for one registered (contact number mentioned in Meridian Finance records) mobile only. In case of change in mobile no, it has to be updated in the record by contacting the HR.
Please refer the Reimbursement Policy for the detail on this policy
Please refer Annexure 5 for the eligibility on Mobile Reimbursements

Family Assistance and Support
All employees of Meridian Finance are covered under the Family assistance and support policy.
Employees across all grades of the company receives the following listed benefits as a part of this policy:
One-time ex-gratia payment of ₹ 2,00,000 for family support
Continued payment of monthly salary to the family for 2 years
Education assistance for children and spouse.

Group Mediclaim Policy and Health & Well-Being Benefits
Group Mediclaim Policy
All employees of Meridian Finance are covered under the Group Mediclaim Policy, which provides reimbursement for medical cost incurred during hospitalization.
Employees are offered cashless as well as reimbursement facilities through a Third-Party Administrator (TPA) as decided by The Company.
The benefit is extended to the family members of the employee. This depends on the eligibility as per the grade.
Under this policy family members are defined as Parents (Father, Mother), Children (2 children - unmarried and below 21 years of age)
The employees are required to submit details of their dependents in the HR portal portal for availing Mediclaim benefits before the day of hospitalization.
Please refer the Employee Benefits Insurance Policy for the detail on this policy
Please refer Annexure 6 for the eligibility on Mediclaim

Annual Health Checkup Facility and Tele-medicine Facility

Annual Health Checkup:
All employees of Meridian Finance are eligible for free annual health check-up, on completion of one year of service.
Employees of age below 35 may avail this facility once in two years, otherwise it may be availed once every year.
For OL III and above grade, this benefit is extended to the spouse of the employee. Please refer Annexure 7 for the detail on coverage as per the eligibility across grades
Telemedicine Facility
This benefit is extended to all the employees of Meridian Finance across all the grades.
Unlimited free virtual consultation with general physician and specialist is provided under this.
Discounted prescribed lab tests and health packages are included in this facility.
Discounted OPD and emergency ambulance service is also provided.
This facility includes discounts on medicine delivery.
Please refer the Employee Benefits Insurance Policy for the detail on this policy.

Group Term Life Insurance
All permanent employees of Meridian Finance are covered under Group Term Life Insurance, to provide insurance cover to family members of the employee in an event of death of him/her due to any reason (natural / unnatural / accidental, except suicide committed within first year from date of joining the company).
The policy is applicable only to the employees and is not extended to his/her family members.
The insurance coverage is based on the Meridian Finance employment grade of an employees. Please refer Annexure 8 for the coverage amount across levels.
Please refer the Employee Benefits Insurance Policy for the detail on this policy.
Group Personal Accident Insurance

All permanent employees of Meridian Finance are covered under Group Personal Accident Insurance, to provide insurance cover to family members of the employee in an event of death of him/her due to an accident or to cover potential risk of loss in earning capacity of an employee arising out of an accident or even death.
The policy does not cover the reimbursement of expenses incurred towards medical treatment in such accidents.
The policy is applicable only to the employee and is not extended to his/her family members.
The insurance coverage is based on the Meridian Finance employment grade of an employee or the nature of injury causing the disability / loss in earning capacity. Please refer Annexure 9 for the coverage amount across levels.
Please refer the Employee Benefits Insurance Policy for the detail on this policy.
