Annexure, 4
FAQs on MGCs:
Which companies are participating in the MGS? At present, the following companies are participating in the MGS:

For the purpose of this document, the term ‘company’ would refer to Meridian Finance & all registered legal entities under the umbrella.

What is the duration of the MGS?

4 years from the date of first investment.

What happens once the 4 years are completed?

On completion of the vesting period of 4 years, the units that were purchased from the employer contributions will be redeemed and paid along with your salary with applicable TDS.

Can I redeem my investment before the 4-year vesting period?

The MGS is designed to help you understand the benefits of regular long-term investing. Hence till the completion of the vesting period, a lien will be marked on the mutual fund units in your folio and in the Trust folio, and withdrawals and transfers will not be permitted. After the 4-year period is completed, you can withdraw (redeem) all the units- including the units purchased through your employer’s matching contribution.
If you choose to permanently withdraw before the 4-year period, the employer matching contribution will be forfeited.

Why are you locking the investments for 4 years?

Through the MGS, we wish to build a mindset towards regular long-term investing among our employees. We believe a 4-year lock-in period will help you experience the benefits of staying invested for the long-term and thereby help you develop the healthy habit of regular investing.

What if I leave the company before completing 4 years?

The investments purchased with your salary deductions will remain unaffected. However, you will lose all the benefits of the mutual fund units purchased through your employer’s contributions.

Can I stop contributing or exit the plan before the completion of the vesting period?

Yes, he can by visiting the employee portal >> View Portfolio >> Cancel MGS
The lien on the units in his folio will then be removed and he will have full transactional rights. However, he will also lose all benefits of the mutual fund units purchased through his employer’s contributions (if any).

What if I am transferred from my present employment to another Meridian Company before completing the vesting period?

If the company you are transferred to is participating in the MGS, your investments and matching contributions will continue and remain unaffected. If the company you are transferred to is not participating in the MGS, then your MGS will be ceased and after completion of the vesting period, the units purchased through your employer’s matching contributions until the transfer will be transferred to your ownership.

What happens if I go on maternity leave?

Your investments and matching contributions will continue during your maternity leave and child care leave.

Can my family member be a co-applicant in the Plan?

This plan is for the benefit of employees and therefore only you can be an applicant. However, you can nominate up to 3 persons as beneficiaries.

I am due for retirement in less than 4 years from now. Can I invest through the MGS?
Yes, you can participate in the MGS. Your date of retirement will be treated as the end of the vesting period and you will be entitled to all the benefits of the plan as on that date.

How much can I invest every month?

You can invest as much as you wish. Your employer will match your investment up to a maximum of Rs 4,000 every month for the first cycle and once the employee has completed 4 years in MGS, he/she becomes eligible to get upto INR 8,000 as employer’s contribution in the new scheme.
The minimum investment amount is Rs. 1000 for Equity, Fund of Funds, Hybrid (equity oriented only) and ELSS schemes and for other schemes. For example, if you choose to invest Rs. 1000 in the HSBC Equity Fund your employer’s contribution will also be Rs. 1000.

How and on what date will the contribution get invested?

Your contribution will be deducted through payroll on the salary date and will be invested on 25th of the month in a folio opened in your name. Your employer's contribution will also be invested on the same day.

I am new to Mutual Funds, where can I get more information about Mutual Funds?

To know more about Mutual Funds in general, please visit www.meridianfinance.com.

Can I invest in any Mutual Fund scheme?

Under the MGS, you can invest only in HSBC Mutual Fund schemes. The following HSBC Mutual Fund Schemes are available for investment through the MGS:

• If your investment amount is equal to Rs. 1000: for the matching employer contribution, you can only select a scheme for which minimum investment amount is also Rs. 1000.

Will I be able to invest in multiple schemes?

Will I receive dividend against the units bought under the MGS?

Since the objective of the MGS is to create wealth, you will be able to invest in the growth option only. This will result in capital appreciation instead of dividend payout.

What if I want to change my investment scheme or amount?

• Every year, during the months of September and October, you will be allowed to modify the amount and/or scheme of your investments.
• Changes made during this window will be applicable to all future instalments. You will receive a confirmation email upon effecting the changes. Your total number of instalments will not change and the balance investments from the modified month till the 48th instalment will be processed in the modified scheme and/or for the modified amount.

I already hold investments with HSBC Mutual Fund. Can I invest in the same Folio?

No, we will open a new folio for investments under the MGS.

Will my MGS investments be eligible for income tax exemptions?

Your investments in HSBC Tax Advantage Fund alone are eligible for income tax exemptions under Section 80C.

If my investments are in the HSBC Tax Advantage Fund, will I be able to redeem them on completion of the vesting period?
Investments in the HSBC Tax Advantage Fund come with tax exemptions and hence have a lock-in period of 3 years. Therefore, redemptions in this scheme would be possible only at the end of 3 years from the date of investment subject to completion of the vesting period.

What are the tax implications when I receive the units purchased through the employer’s matching contributions?

The value of the transferred units will be treated as part of your salary and tax will be deducted at source as per the prevailing income tax regulations. The cost of transfer, if any will have to be borne by the employee.

When the units are transferred to my folio, apart from TDS, will I be liable for capital gain tax also?

At the time of transfer, no other tax other than the TDS will be applicable for the value of the units transferred to you. This is subject to the then prevailing tax laws.

What are the tax implications if I withdraw (redeem) the units once they are transferred to my folio?

How can I participate in the MGS?

To register for the MGS:
• Click the Register link in the top menu.
• Fill in the online form
If you are KYC verified, your MGS will be instantly activated. Else, you will need to download the KYC form through the “Download Documents” tab. It will also be emailed to you.
• Sign the form and attach necessary supporting documents as specified in it.
• Submit the completed documents at the specified point of submission in your office. You can contact your Admin support personnel for further details. You can also send the documents to the following address:
MGS Services
KGN Towers, 6th floor, No.62 Ethiraj Salai, (Commander-In-Chief Road)
Egmore, Chennai, 600 105

If your documents are found to be in order and verified before 14th of a month, your first salary deduction and matching contribution will be processed in the same month.

What are the documents that I should submit to complete my registration?

If you are already KYC verified, you need not submit any documents. You will be allowed to register for MGS instantly upon receiving your login credentials.
If you are not KYC verified, KYC(CKYC) formalities should be fulfilled as per the process given in the mail.

Is there any specific date before which I have to register?

To be eligible for salary deduction and investment in the same month, the employee needs to complete the registration process before the 10th of the month. ie: The employee needs to ensure that his documents reach HSBC MF before the 14th of the month. Else, his MGS investment will begin from the subsequent month.

Will you keep me updated about the investments in my MGS account?

Yes, you will receive account statements by email after your installment is processed every month. In addition, when you log in to the MGS portal (the employee portal)you will be able to see the details of your investments and your employer’s contributions under the “My Portfolio” tab.

If I have queries / complaints regarding my investments, how can I get them resolved?

For assistance, you can either write to us at helpdesk@meridianfinance.com or call us on 1800 2000 600 (toll-free) from Monday to Friday, 8 a.m. to 8 p.m. and Saturday, 9.am to 1 p.m.

I wish to make further investments in HSBC mutual funds beyond the MGS. Whom should I contact?

You can call the dedicated helpline 1800 2000 600 to fix an appointment with our service personnel who will guide you with your further investments.

Women-friendly policies are the initiatives and guidelines implemented by Meridian Finance in order to create a supportive and enabling work environment for women employees. These policies aim to address the unique challenges and needs that women may face in the workplace especially during their maternity period.
For the purpose of this document, the term ‘company’ would refer to Meridian Finance & all registered legal entities under the umbrella.
Please note that all policies and processes stipulated in this version shall supersede those set out in any earlier versions.
Meridian Finance will endeavor to update this policy as and when required. Notwithstanding, Meridian Finance will follow the prevailing statutory requirements at the point of any application / notification.

Introduction

Meridian Finance is committed to being a great place to work and an inclusive and enabling employer. Our country’s social fabric and legacy is such that women take on a larger role when it comes to shouldering the responsibility towards the domestic front. Hence, it is Meridian Finance’s endeavour to create a level playing field to enable women employees to balance their personal and work life through the policies and practices.

Policy Objectives

This Policy provides the guidelines for providing a supportive and conducive work environment for all women employees through flexible work arrangements, adequate maternity leave, support for new mothers when they are transitioning back to office and necessary enablers to ensure their wellbeing at each stage.
This policy enables women employees to effectively use their potential and skills to contribute at the work place in times of their need.
The policy provides a framework for women employees to avail relevant benefits in the overarching organizational context and requirements.

Policy Management

3.1 Policy Application and Interpretation

This policy will be in effect from 1st October, 2024. The policy will apply to all Full Time Women Employees of Meridian Finance & all registered legal entities under the umbrella.
Meridian Finance’s C&B Team or the HR SPOCs (BHRs) will resolve any queries regarding policy interpretation and application. Any exceptions to the Policy will require the CHRO’s written approval.
3.2 Policy Amendments and Updates

The management reserves the right to amend this policy at any time. When and where a change in this policy is made the company undertakes to notify the employees as soon as is feasible.
Policy Communication and Compliance
Meridian Finance will effectively communicate the policy to all employees, ensuring that they understand their rights, responsibilities, and the procedures to be followed.
Training sessions or informational materials (such as Employee Handbook) are provided to ensure clarity at the time of on-boarding.
Meridian Finance is responsible for accurately providing women employees with their entitled benefits in accordance with legal requirements and company policies.
Employees are expected to familiarize themselves with the Women Friendly Policy and comply with its provisions. This includes understanding the types of benefits available, eligibility criteria, documentation requirements, and any restrictions or limitations.

Comfort Days, 02 (TWO) Days of Work from home for Women Employees

Scope
All permanent women employees of Meridian Finance & all registered legal entities under the umbrella will be eligible to avail of the benefit. New Joiners will be eligible from the month subsequent to their month of joining.
Policy Tenets
Women employees will be provided the option of additional 02 (TWO) days of Work from home per calendar month to help them meet any personal health exigency / discomfort associated with their menses.
Women employees may opt to take these 02 (TWO) days without any prior intimation; however, they do need to inform their manager on the day they are availing the same
Women employees availing of this benefit are required to ensure that any business/work exigencies are dealt with and that their work deliverables are not impacted.
In every role there are certain tasks that can be carried out in a WFH without any IT infrastructure requirements. In such cases where for any woman employee, the relevant IT infrastructure etc to opt for WFH facility is absent, then women employees need to align with her Immediate Supervisor and the respective BHR SPOC well in advance to identify the relevant tasks in order to avail of these “Comfort Days”
Women employees need not provide any reason for availing of these 02 (TWO) days of WFH.
The 02 (TWO) days will lapse at the end of the calendar month and will not be carried forward.
The 02 (TWO) days may be taken one day at a time and at any two intervals within a span of 5 Calendar days.
Women employees will need to update the same in the the HR portal system
The comfort days may be clubbed with declared holidays / other leave types / WFA as applicable within the prescribed individual limits.
The process to avail Comfort Days in the HR portal is as follows:
Path:

the HR portal Login >> Attendance & Time Off >> Apply for Work from Anywhere/OD >> Comfort Days

Maternity Wellness & Support Policy

Prenatal Care/Pre-Maternity Care Policy

Pre-Maternity Travel Assistance Allowance

Scope
All permanent women employees of Meridian Finance & all registered legal entities under the umbrella fulfilling the following conditions are eligible to avail of the policy, Women employees who are in the family way with their first or their second child during their tenure with Meridian Finance.
Women employees who are utilizing public transportation to commute to and from their office location and are not availing of the EOCS / COCS schemes.
Policy Tenets
All such eligible women employees will be given an additional travelling assistance allowance per month
For office location in Metro cities (Mumbai, Delhi, Kolkata and Chennai) the amount payable will be INR 5,500/- per month
For office location in Non, Metro cities the amount payable will be INR 4,500/- per month
The allowance will be paid over and above the CTC and any taxes if applicable will apply.
Eligible women employees are required to raise the request along with the relevant documents as mentioned in the Annexure 1.
To avail of the benefit the employee will be required to provide supporting documentation by way of their doctor’s written confirmation of their pregnancy along with a copy of their blood test report / conception diagnostic test report.
This allowance will not be a part of their CTC and will not be included when calculating future increments or any other emoluments.
The allowance will be paid out effective from the month of application and not retrospectively, i.e, if the woman employee applies in the month of March 2025, then post review of the company doctor of the documents submitted the allowance will be paid effective March 2025.
The benefit will continue to be paid on monthly basis till the attainment of whichever milestone comes earlier, Completion of that calendar month in which the delivery date is expected as confirmed by the company doctor not exceeding eight months from the month of applying for the benefit.
Commencement of the maternity leave of the woman employee.
Intimation from the woman employee to her BHR SPOC or manager about termination of the pregnancy owing to unforeseen / adverse circumstances.
The process along with the relevant guidelines and points to be mindful of while availing this allowance are detailed out in Annexure 1.

ii. Preferential / Reserved Parking for Expecting Mothers

Scope
All permanent women employees of Meridian Finance & all registered legal entities under the umbrella fulfilling the following conditions are eligible to avail of the policy -
Women employees who are in the family way with their first or their second child during their tenure with Meridian Finance.
Women employees who are experiencing discomfort or any specific symptoms during any trimester of their pregnancy and yet are coming physically to office to discharge their duties.
Policy Tenets
Wherever possible such women employees will be provided reserved / preferential parking spaces for their own vehicle on submitting a request for the same to their BHR SPOC. BHR SPOC will work with the FCM team to facilitate this.
Proximity of the parking spot to office entry and exit access / elevators / lifts will be taken into account.
Meridian Finance will try their best to accommodate the requests on a first come first served basis.
Meridian Finance will be humane and inclusive when allotting preferential / reserved parking with a focus on the comfort of the expecting mother.

iii. Preferential / Reserved Seating spaces for Expecting Mothers

Scope
All permanent women employees of Meridian Finance & all registered legal entities under the umbrella fulfilling the following conditions are eligible to avail of the policy.
Women employees who are in the family way with their first or their second child during their tenure with Meridian Finance.
Women employees who are experiencing discomfort or any specific symptoms during any trimester of their pregnancy and yet are coming physically to office to discharge their duties.

Policy Tenets
Wherever possible such women employees will be provided preferential / reserved seating spaces on submitting a request for the same to their BHR SPOC. BHR SPOC will work with the FCM team to facilitate this.
Proximity to office entry and exit access / washrooms / elevators / lifts as per the employee’s preference will be taken into account when allotting a seat.
Meridian Finance will try their best to accommodate the requests on a first come first served basis.
Meridian Finance will also enable provision of an ergonomically compliant workspace.
Meridian Finance will be humane and inclusive when allotting reserved seating with the focus being on the comfort of the expecting mother.

6.2 Postnatal Care/Post-Maternity care Policy

Work From Anywhere flexibility upto 26 Weeks for Mothers of infants / Women employees having child upto 18 (eighteen) months of age

Scope
All permanent women employees of Meridian Finance & all registered legal entities under the umbrella will be eligible to avail of the policy subject to the following -
The woman employee should have a job role that is conducive to working from anywhere.
New joiners should have worked for at least 03 (three) months post joining in their defined base work location / office and the age of the child should not exceed 18 months at the time of applying for the WFA.

Policy Tenets
All permanent women employees with children of age less than 18 (Eighteen) months shall be eligible for up to 26 (Twenty-Six) weeks of Work from Anywhere subject to their job role allowing for the same.
This flexibility may be availed of over and above the Maternity leave policy and the child care leave policy and any other leave types as applicable.
Women employees may apply for Maternity leave, Child Care leave and Work from Anywhere, if eligible, in succession or combination subject to the condition that the total duration that the woman employee is away from their defined base work location / office starting from the date of maternity should not exceed 52 weeks OR 01 (one) calendar year.
In the event that a woman employee returns to work immediately after completing the maternity leave and after some time requests for Child care leave and / or Work From Anywhere in succession or combination she will be eligible for the same subject to the condition that the total duration that the woman employee is away from her defined base work location / office starting from the date on which the first facility is availed should not exceed 26 weeks OR 0.5 (half) calendar year.
Those Women employees who are new joiners to Meridian Finance and have a child who has not yet attained the age of 18 (Eighteen) months, should they fulfil all other eligibility criteria, may avail of the Child care leave and Work From Anywhere in succession or combination subject to the condition that the total duration that the woman employee is away from their defined base work location / office starting from the date on which the first facility is availed should not exceed 26 weeks OR 0.5 (half) calendar year.
Both the Child Care Leave and Work from Anywhere will lapse in the end of the month that the child attains 18 (Eighteen) months of age.
The option of Work From Anywhere may not be availed of if the woman employee has resigned / is serving notice period.
Refer to the Annexure 2 for illustrative examples.
Women employees who wish to avail of this WFA are required to reach out to their BHR SPOC.
The BHR SPOC will do the necessary due diligence and discuss with the relevant stakeholders (line manager, head of department and BHR head) and seek their formal sign off.
Once signed off BHR SPOC will inform the woman employee as well as formally email the same to leave.helpdesk@meridianfinance.com for system Updation.
Child Care Leave Policy

Scope
All permanent women employees of Meridian Finance & all registered legal entities under the umbrella will be eligible to avail of the policy. Any new joiners will be eligible to avail this policy subject to having worked for at least 3 (three) months post their joining in their defined base work location / office.

Policy Tenets
All permanent women employees with children of age less than 18 (Eighteen) months shall be eligible for up to 14 (Fourteen) weeks of PAID Childcare Leave.
Childcare leave may be taken anytime for a minimum continuous period of 4 (Four) weeks and for as long as may be required upto a maximum of 14 (Fourteen) weeks till the child reaches 18 (eighteen) months of age.
This leave type may only be availed ONCE per child till the child reaches 18 (eighteen) months of age.
This leave type is over and above the maternity leave
This leave type is applicable for the first two children only.
The Child care leave will lapse in the end of the month that the child attains 18 (Eighteen) months of age
Women employees who wish to avail of the Child care leave are required to reach out to their BHR SPOC
The BHR SPOC will do the necessary due diligence and discuss with the relevant stakeholders (line manager, head of department and BHR head) and seek their formal sign off
Once signed off BHR SPOC will inform the woman employee as well as formally email the same to leave.helpdesk@meridianfinance.com for system Updation.
Child Care Attendant Travel Policy

Scope
All permanent women employees of Meridian Finance & all registered legal entities under the umbrella will be eligible to avail of the policy. This is subject to the condition that their role requires them to travel outside of their defined base work location for business purposes.
Policy Tenets
All permanent women employees with children of age less than 06 (Six) years shall be eligible for this benefit.
The benefit will apply till the end of the month in which the child attains 06 (Six) years of age
All such women employees who are eligible will have the right to have an attendant accompany them if they are travelling along with their child for any pre-approved business reasons that requires their physical presence in any location outside of their defined base work location.
The woman employee must make sure that the child & the attendant joins the business travel for the entire duration of the business trip from start to end and not midway.
Meridian Finance will bear the cost of travel, boarding and lodging of the said attendant and the child only if they are travelling along with the employee.
Accommodation for the child and the attendant will be provided on sharing basis along with the woman employee.
Women employees may avail of the benefit by calling out the same in the free text remarks column when raising their travel request on the HR portal, FCM team will facilitate the same.
For the purpose of this policy an Attendant is defined as any one of the following, Nanny
Governess
Ayah
Wet nurse
Hired help
Any blood relative of the woman employee
Any relative of the woman employee by law
Any friend who is supporting the woman employee take care of the child at the time

Creche/Day Care Reimbursement Policy

Scope
All permanent women employees of Meridian Finance & all registered legal entities under the umbrella will be eligible to avail of the policy fulfilling the following conditions -
Their child / children is / are below 6 (six) years of age
Their child / children is / are enrolled in a creche / day care

Policy Tenets
In such cases where both the above stated conditions as per Clause iv (a) are fulfilled, such women employees will be provided reimbursement of creche / day care costs against supporting documents.
The maximum amount reimbursable per child per month will be, INR 15,000/- (fifteen thousand) per month in metro cities (Delhi, Mumbai, Kolkata, Chennai)
INR 10,000/- (ten thousand) per month in non-metro cities
Reimbursement will be given till the child attains 6 (six) years of age.
Reimbursement will be given for a maximum of 2 (two) children per woman employee.
Reimbursement will be processed against relevant original supporting documents as mentioned in Annexure 3.
The process along with the relevant guidelines and points to be mindful of while availing of the same are detailed out in the Annexure 3.

Part time working

Scope
All permanent women employees of Meridian Finance & all registered legal entities under the umbrella will be eligible to avail of the policy. This is subject to their having worked for at least 01 (ONE) year post joining in their defined base work location / office.

Policy Tenets
Any women employee, depending on personal situations, e.g.: taking care of aged parents/ parents in laws; illness in family; children’s education etc. may choose to work for half day for a certain period. Such applications may be submitted to the Business HR. Business HR, post discussion with the department head and the CHRO will take a decision and convey the same to the employee.
The employee may choose to work either half of the day i.e., half day will be available as either first half of the day i.e., 9:30am to 2pm or 2pm to 6:30pm only. It is important to note that the half day can be availed altogether in a block and cannot be availed in a scattered manner on a given day.
Employee can opt for working either in the first half or the second half as per the specified work timings only. During this period, the employee will accordingly be eligible for half day pay only. Performance pay will be prorated accordingly.
Leave earned for employees on part time work will be 13 days i.e., 12 days Privilege leave plus 01 Special Day leave. If the employee is eligible for Casual leaves, then it will also be pro-rated accordingly and hence maximum of 06 (six) CLs will be credited.
Women employees who wish to avail of the part time work arrangement are required to reach out to their BHR SPOC.
The BHR SPOC will do the necessary due diligence and discuss with the relevant stakeholders (line manager, head of department and BHR head) and seek their formal sign off.
Once signed off, BHR SPOC will inform the woman employee as well as formally email the same to leave.helpdesk@meridianfinance.com for system Updation.
The employee will need to state the duration for which this benefit is being sought. If the employee wishes to extend the benefit, then she must approach the BHR SPOC with an application to this effect.
BHR SPOC, post discussion with the department head and the CHRO will take a decision and convey the same to the employee.
The benefit will normally be available for a period of upto six months. Employees should note that this benefit can be availed in a block of 6 months and cannot be availed in a scattered manner.
The management at its sole discretion reserves the right to modify or amend this Policy at any time as it deems the circumstances warrant.
The women employee shall not take up any alternative employment during this period.
An employee who does not wish to return to work at the end of the duration of the period must give the organization notice of resignation as required by her contract of employment.

Sabbatical Leave

Scope
All permanent women employees of Meridian Finance & all registered legal entities under the umbrella will be eligible to avail of the policy subject to having worked for at least 01 (ONE) year post joining in their defined base work location / office.
Policy Tenets
An Employee, depending on personal situations, e.g.: taking care of aged parents/ parents in laws; illness. family: children’s education etc. may require to be away from work for a continuous period, such a period will be termed as ‘Sabbatical Leave’.
Applications for ‘Sabbatical Leave’ may be submitted to the BHR SPOC. BHR SPOC, post discussion with the department head and the CHRO will take a decision and convey the same to the employee.
During this period of Sabbatical, the employee will continue to be on the rolls of the organization. The Sabbatical period will be initially adjusted against the existing PL balance and balance period will be at no pay.
The period in which an employee is on Sabbatical leave will not be considered for computing of Performance pay.
The employee will need to state the duration for which this benefit is being sought. If the employee wishes to extend the benefit, then she must approach the Business HR with an application to this effect.
BHR SPOC, post discussion with the department head and the CHRO will take a decision and convey the same to the employee.
The benefit will normally be available for a period upto six months. Employees should note that this benefit can be availed in a block of 6 months and cannot be availed in a scattered manner.
The management at its sole discretion reserves the right to modify or amend this Policy at any time as it deems the circumstances warrant.
The women employee shall not take up any alternative employment during this period.
An employee who does not wish to return to work at the end of the duration of the period must give the organization notice of resignation as required by her Appointment letter.

DISCLAIMER, Management reserves the discretionary right to modify or amend the policy tenets as and when they deem fit, wherever feasible they will communicate in the appropriate manner should there be any changes. Taxation impact if any will be applicable to the employee.

ANNEXURES

Annexure, 01

User Guide and Process: To avail Pre-Maternity Travel Assistance Allowance

Women Employees are required to approach their BHR SPOC for enabling the allowance.
Women Employees are required to provide a copy of their conception diagnostic test report along with a copy of their doctor’s written confirmation of their pregnancy, scanned copies of the same may be shared via email with the BHR SPOC.
The BHR SPOC is required to approach the company doctor to get the documents provided reviewed and take a confirmation on the expected delivery date. In the event that the company doctor requires any additional information or details, the BHR SPOC will facilitate the same.
Once the company doctor provides their final inputs, the BHR SPOC will intimate the payroll team to initiate the travel allowance as per the policy along with the relevant document copies.
Payroll team to cross check the relevant details and initiate the allowance. For all practical purposes only Mumbai, Delhi, Chennai and Kolkata will be considered as Metro cities. Also, the office base location city of the employee is to be considered.
BHR SPOC to intimate the payroll team to stop the payment once the woman employee applies for maternity leave or if the BHR SPOC receives any information from the employee regarding termination of the pregnancy for any reason.
In the event that no information is shared by the BHR SPOC for early stop, the payroll team will continue to pay the allowance till the month in which the delivery is expected as per the company doctor.

Annexure, 02

Scenario, Existing woman employee of Meridian Finance goes on maternity leave from 01st June 2024:

In such a case she may avail of, 26 weeks of maternity leave as per policy
UP TO 14 weeks of child care leave as per policy
UP TO 26 (TWENTY-SIX) weeks / half calendar year of Work from Anywhere for mother of young infants subject to eligibility as per policy
Possible combinations she may avail of in continuation or in parts are as below (subject to the overall limit),
In such a scenario if the start date is 01st June 2024, and all 03 benefits are availed in continuation, then the end date post which the woman employee must report physically to her defined base location is 31st May 2025. If a woman employee opts for the child care leave and / or the WFA option post returning to work after maternity she may do so till the child attains 18 months of age but overall limit of max 52 weeks of physical absence will still apply. If the woman employee does not wish to return to work at the end of the 52 week period then she will be required to give notice as detailed in the terms and conditions of her appointment letter.
Scenario, B- New Joiner woman employee of Meridian Finance who is eligible wants to avail of Child care leave and WFA from 01st June 2024 OR Existing woman employee who joined back post maternity leave wants to avail of Child care leave and WFA from 01st June 2024:
In such a case she may avail of, UP TO 14 weeks of child care leave as per policy
UP TO 26 (TWENTY-SIX) weeks / half calendar year of Work from Anywhere for mother of young infants subject to eligibility as per policy
Possible combinations she may avail of in continuation or in parts are as below (subject to the overall limit),
In this scenario if the start date is 01st June 2024 then the end date post which the woman employee is required to physically report to the defined base work location is 30th November 2024. If a woman employee opts for the child care leave and / or the WFA option parts she may do so till the child attains 18 months of age but overall limit of max 26 weeks of physical absence will still apply.
If the woman employee does not wish to return to work at the end of the 26 (Twenty-six) weeks/ 0.5 (half) year period then she will be required to give notice as detailed in the terms and conditions of her appointment letter.

Annexure, 03

User Guide and Process: To avail Creche / Day Care reimbursement
Women Employees are required to approach their BHR SPOC for claiming the Creche / Day Care reimbursement.
On the first request the Women Employees are required to provide, Birth certificate of the child / children
Registration certificate of the creche
In addition to the above the Woman employee will also be required to provide the valid bill along with proof of payment. If the bill does not have the GST details, then a copy of the GST certificate will also be required. The bill will need to be produced on monthly basis to claim the reimbursements.
The BHR SPOC is required to review the documents and share the same with the payroll team.
Payroll team to cross check the relevant details and enable processing of the payment via the F&A team.
Payment is subject to submission of bills, women employees after the first request may choose to submit the subsequent bills on a quarterly basis however bills from any given financial year must be submitted before 15th March of that year.
Payments to be made effective from the month in which the reimbursement application is submitted, no retrospective payments are to be made

This Policy document provides a framework on the process and guidelines for the various stages involved in the Non Front-line hiring process.

Any questions and suggestions on the implementation of the policy manual should be directed to the ‘Authorized Personnel’.

For the purpose of this document, the term ‘company’ would refer to Meridian Finance & all registered legal entities under the umbrella.

Meridian Finance will endeavour to update this policy as required.

INTRODUCTION

This policy document outlines the standardized framework for recruitment and selection of Non Front-line employees at Meridian Finance, India. It ensures a fair, inclusive, and merit-based approach throughout the hiring process.

Policy Objective

The objective of this policy are as follows:
To create a “One Meridian Finance Talent Pool” which involves hiring and maintaining talent to be groomed into versatile business leaders.
To attract the best fit talent and the policy and process defined herewith aims to provide a positive, professional & unified hiring experience.
To hire candidates for approved positions, basis capability rather just domain knowledge and experience.

1.1 Policy Management

1.2.1 Policy Application and Interpretation

This policy will be in effect from _________.

The Recruitment Team is responsible for resolving any questions regarding its interpretation and application. Exceptions to the policy require written approval from the Chief Human Resources Officer (CHRO).

1.2.2 Policy Amendments and Updates
The Company reserves the right to amend this policy at any time. When and where a change in this policy is made the company undertakes to notify the employees as soon as feasible.

Manpower Planning and Budgeting

3.1 For Retail Business RCU and Credit
The company employs a two, pronged approach for the retail business, RCU and Credit departments to budget for staffing needs: monthly basis (MOM) and location wise.
Some of the key stakeholders involved in this are Business head, Company executives (CE) and Head HR.
A well-defined workflow is adhered to before cascading the final plan down the hierarchy for implementation.
Annual budgets are set, then reviewed in Q2 to identify any gaps between planned and actual manpower requirements.

3.2 For Group Functions and Wholesale Business

Manpower Planning & Budgeting is an annual exercise undertaken for this business unit and functions at the firm.
The company employs a two, pronged approach to budgeting for staffing needs: monthly basis (MOM), grade and if warranted then location is also considered.
Some of the key stakeholders involved in this are respective Business head, Company executives (CE), Head HR and CFO.

3.3 Process Description for Manpower Budgeting
The Business Head HR reviews hierarchies and span of control and plan manpower budget.
The Business Head HR reviews the productivity of each individual/group.
The scope of work vis-à-vis job descriptions is defined to identify gap areas.
This process is undertaken one month before the beginning of the Financial Year.

Creating and Publishing Requisition ID
4.1 For Retail Business RCU and Credit
This is generated by the Central HR for the Retail Business, RCU and Credit Units. The the HR portal platform allows for simultaneous creation of employee grades, designations, and reporting structures.
New requisition is published in the HR portal by the TA team in order to start sourcing for the suitable candidate.
Note that a replacement requisition is auto created when a resignation is updated in the HR portal.

For Group Functions and Wholesale Business

In case of Wholesales Business and Group Functions, Business HR receives the requisition from the respective stakeholder.
New requisition is published in the HR portal by the BHR/TA team in order to start sourcing for the suitable candidate.
Note that similar to the Retail, RCU and Credit Function, a replacement requisition is auto created when a resignation is updated in the HR portal.

4.3 Process Description for creating and publishing Requisition ids
New Requisitions:
Any Requisition (Budgeted/ Unbudgeted) can be raised by Recruitment Team.
New Requisitions are created by Central Retail HRs in the the HR portal as per the budget received Created Requisitions can be put on hold in the HR portal in case of hiring freeze.
This step takes place on receipt of the Budget.
Steps to create a new requisition id:
Login to ‘the HR portal’ and change the role to ‘Business-HR’ from the Role Card
Click on ‘Talent Acquisition’
Under Budgeting & Planning section, click on ‘Create Budgeted/ Unbudgeted Req with Workflow’
MRF form will be displayed
Once all the details are filled, you need to submit the form.
Refer Annexure, 1 for the detail process.

Replacement Requisitions:
Replacement requisition is auto created when resignation is updated in the HR portal
This is done at the time of resignation of employees in the the HR portal

Publishing Requisition Requirement in the HR portal
The BHR will publish the new Requisition in the HR portal in order to start sourcing and add a candidate against the position
Replacement requisition is visible to the hiring manager only when it is approved and published by Recruiter
Steps to Publish a requirement are:
Go to ‘Sourcing’ in order to publish the requirement
Click on ‘Publish Requirement’
Click on the highlighted option against the requisition number
A form will be displayed in which details are to be captured such as Recruiter, Interview category, Consultant, etc. Multiple recruiters and consultants can be added
When all the required details are filled, click on save
On publishing the requisition, BHR can add a candidate
This step takes place after creating a new Requisition id
In order to rationalize the cost of hiring, the respective recruitment managers are advised to exhaust the existing cost-effective channels of recruitment, which are other than consultants.
Refer Annexure, 2 for the detail process

Sourcing of Candidates

5.1 For Retail Business RCU and Credit and Group Functions and Wholesale Business
Sourcing of Candidates is a crucial step and various sourcing channels are tapped to build talent pipeline such as:
Talent Partners
Career Website/Job portals
Employee Referral Program
Internal Job postings
Rehiring ex-employees

Process Description for Candidates Search

Various sourcing channels are tapped to build talent pipeline by the BHRs. This is done on an on-going basis.
Following are the main sources of recruitment:

Career Website/Job Portals: - Career Website/ Job portals like Naukri, iimjobs, LinkedIn, Shine can be used by the team for sourcing applications. (https://www.naukri.com/, https://www.shine.com/, https://in.linkedin.com/, https://www.iimjobs.com/. (Refer Annexure, 3)
Employee Referral Program, The employee referral program is designed to provide a platform to existing employees for referring friends, ex-colleagues, associates, professional acquaintances for possible employment with Meridian Finance whenever suitable vacancies are available. (Refer Annexure, 4)
Internal Job Posting, Internal job postings (Aspire) on the HR portal to encourage employees to take up new and challenging roles. (Refer Annexure, 5)

Talent Partner, Inviting profiles from empaneled consultants. Sourcing partners are briefed about job profile, eligibility criteria and interview process. (Refer Annexure, 6)
Rehiring Ex-employees, An ex-employee can also be looked at for hiring for a job role suitable to his profile and experience, provided he / she meets the re-hiring criteria. (Refer Annexure, 7)

Add Candidate detail and update profile
Details of selected candidates can be entered in published requisition in the HR portal in any one of the following ways:

Add / Edit a Candidate: BHR has to manually update all the candidate details in the HR portal using the candidate’s CV.

Steps To add a Candidate

the HR portal > Talent Acquisition > Sourcing > Add/Edit a candidate
List of requisitions will be displayed in the dropdown. Select the requisition number to add a candidate
Candidate can apply for job positions from the Company Website
Once a candidate is added, unique candidate ID is created. The application is sent to BHR for screening

Resume Parsing (Skillate): Inbuilt resume parser in the HR portal (Skillate) to help BHR parse the resume without filling all the details manually.

Steps To add a Candidate

the HR portal > Talent Acquisition > Sourcing > Resume Parser
List of requisitions will be displayed in the dropdown. Select the requisition number to add a candidate
Click on “Add” to parse and add the CV
Select the “Source” of the CV and upload the CV to be parsed
Once parsed, the Candidate ID will be generated, and the CV will be tagged to the required requisition.

Resumes tagged by Talent Partners: All empaneled Talent Partners are given access to upload resumes against the requisitions which are published by the BHRs to the particular Talent Partner.

Steps by BHR to publish a requisition to a Talent Partner

the HR portal > Talent Acquisition > Sourcing > Publish Requirement
Click on the highlighted option against the requisition number
A form will be displayed in which details are to be captured such as Recruiter, Interview category, Consultant, etc. Multiple recruiters and consultants can be added
Select from the list of empaneled Talent Partners to whom the requisition needs to be published along with the maximum number of CVs they can upload on the HR portal against the published requisition
When all the required details are filled, click on ‘Save’.
Once a requisition is published to a Talent Partner, they can view the Requisition along with details (role, location, JD, experience etc.) and upload the relevant CVs.

Steps to be taken by Talent Partner to upload the CV

Login to the HR portal using the login ID and password shared by the Central Recruitment team
All the requisitions published to the Talent partners will be visible on their login page
Add the CVs (within the max limit) against the requisition number
When all the required details are filled, click on ‘Save’
Once the CV is uploaded, the BHR will be able to view the same

Resumes received from Employee Referral scheme: Employees can upload the resumes against the requisitions which are published by the BHRs on Employee Referral portal in the HR portal.
Alternately, even the BHRs can upload the CVs of candidates referred by employees over email. (Refer Annexure, 4)

Resumes received from Internal Job Postings: Employees can upload the resumes against the requisitions which are published by the BHRs for Internal Job Postings (Aspire) in the HR portal. (Refer Annexure, 5).

De-dupe check in the HR portal

De-dupe check is built in the HR portal and it will not allow to add candidate in case of Rehiring, where duplicate records of ex-employee is found.

Rehiring is enabled in the HR portal post approval from Head-BHR, if the ex-employee is eligible as per the criteria This access is controlled by the HR-Ops system admin, who checks for mail approval from Head-BHR, before enabling rehiring. Mail approval to be included with joining documents file of the candidate for future records. (Refer Annexure, 7).

This process is taken up at the time of adding candidate profile.

Screening of Candidates
6.1 For Retail Business RCU and Credit and Group Functions and Wholesale Business
The candidate selection process follows a two-step approach.
Initially, TA team and BHR conducts a screening to identify qualified applicants. Subsequently, shortlisted candidates progress to interviews with the reporting manager.

6.2 Process Description for Screening of Candidates
Resume Screening:

Once all the candidates are added to the requisition number, BHR screens all the resumes and shortlists the ones which will go to the next step of “Interview”.

Steps to follow while navigating:
Log in to the HR portal as Business-HR
Go to Talent Acquisition > Evaluation > Resume Screening
The list of all requisitions and corresponding candidates added to the same.
Click on ‘Screening” to select the desired option among “Shortlisted / Rejected / On-hold” and add comments mandatorily. Click on “Save”.

Manager Screening

Once all resumes are screened by the BHR, next step is the screening by Reporting Manager.

Navigation for Reporting Manager:
Log in to the HR portal
Go to Talent Acquisition > About my Team > Candidate Screening
The list of all requisitions and corresponding candidates added to the same.
Click on ‘Screening” > Change status of candidate (Selected / Rejected / Hold) along with suitable comments > Submit

Navigation for BHR:
Log in to the HR portal
Go to Talent Acquisition > Evaluation > Manager
The list of all requisitions and corresponding candidates added to the same.
Click on ‘Screening” > Change status of candidate (Selected / Rejected / Hold) along with suitable comments > Submit

Interview Process

7.1 For Retail Business RCU and Credit

The TA team looks after Interview panel composition.
After the manager screening is done the TA team schedules an interview round in which the date and time of the interview is communicated to the candidate.
Also, the Interview type (personal/telephonic/video conference), Interview location, Primary Interviewer and Secondary Interviewer are mentioned while scheduling on the HR portal.
In the Interview Process panelists select/reject the candidates and Interview Evaluation Sheet (IES) is updated on the the HR portal by the TA team.

7.2 For Group Functions and Wholesale Business

TA team / BHR looks after Interview panel composition.
TA team / BHR schedules the interview as per the common availability of the interview panel and candidate.
Interview stage / Level at Functional level:
FL - One (Reporting manager)
FML, Two (Reporting manager & respective Business Leader)
OL & above, Two (Business Leader & CE)
BHR interview is common across grade.
In the Interview Process panelists select/reject the candidates and Interview Evaluation Sheet (IES) is updated on the the HR portal by the TA team.

7.3 Process Description for Selection Process
On Meridian Finance Platform

Consistent functional skills and behavioral attributes should be assessed during the interview. The technique is also commonly known as the STAR method, Situation, Task, Action, and Result. Few examples of behavioral attributes:
Drive for achievement
Ability to influence
Work ethic (Conscientious, diligent, hardworking, persevering)
Resilience (Capacity to bounce back from difficult situations)
Analytical and Conceptual thinking

Interview Panel Composition

Post BHR and Manager screening, BHR schedules an interview round, where the date and time of interview is informed to the candidate.
Steps to Navigate:
Log in to the HR portal as Business-HR
Go to Talent Acquisition > Evaluation > Interview Schedule (by candidate)
The list of all requisitions is placed along with the number of shortlisted candidates against each requisition
Select on the shortlisted candidate, and schedule interview for the candidate by mentioning:
Interview date
Interview type (personal / telephonic / video conference)
Interview location
Primary interviewer (PS ID of Business Panelist)
Secondary interviewer (PS ID of BHR)
Click on “Mail to candidate” and “Mail to Interviewer” to send the interview schedule invite

Interview Process

Panelists select / reject the candidates through interview process
Interview Evaluation sheet (IES) or communication mail of selected candidates are filled and uploaded in the HR portal.
This process is to be done by the Business Panelist on the day of the interview.
Steps to navigate:
Login to the HR portal > Talent Acquisition > About my team > Scheduled Interview
All the scheduled interviews will be visible in a tabular form
Click on “Action” to decide whether to process or re-schedule the interview
In case you click on “Process”, a new window opens where you need to submit the interview feedback ad upload the IES sheet in the “Interview Sheet” tab
In case you click on “Reschedule”, a new window opens where you can select a new date and time for the interview, and these details will flow to the BHR for re-scheduling the interview
Refer Annexure, 9 for the detail process

Post Selection and Pre-Offer Release Stage

8.1 Process Description applicable to all non-frontline hirings

Upload mandatory Documents
Once the candidate is selected in the HR portal, he / she will receive an e-mail trigger with a link to upload the following mandatory documents in the HR portal
Pan card
Salary slips of 3 months
NISM Certification (Only in case of hiring for Investment Management business)
Navigation Steps for Candidate:
the HR portal > Initiate Document Verification > Upload documents in the tabs provided. Click on ‘Submit’
In case the candidate is not able to upload the mandatory documents, same can be done by the BHR on their behalf.
Navigation Steps for BHR:
Login to the HR portal as Business-HR
Go to Talent Acquisition > Pre-joining > Pre-offer Document Upload
All the requisitions for which mandatory documents need to be uploaded will be visible
Click on “Upload” tab in the “Action” column to upload the documents

Pre-offer verification of Documents
Once the candidate uploads mandatory documents, BHR needs to verify the same
Navigation Steps for BHR:
Login to the HR portal as Business-HR
Go to Talent Acquisition > Pre-joining > Pre-offer Document Verification
All the requisitions for which mandatory documents uploaded by the candidate will be visible
Click on “Verify” tab in the “Action” column which will populate all the uploaded documents
BHR will need to “Select / Reject” against each of the uploaded document to complete the verification
Then click on “Submit”

Employment Credential check on the credit information company
Candidate’s employment credentials are checked on the credit information company basis DOB, Aadhar and PAN. In case PAN is not available, the verification is done basis DOB & Aadhar. In these cases, application acknowledgement of PAN is obtained.
In case of no records found/ normal exit, recruiter proceeds with verification and uploads the report in the the credit information company tab in Upload Documents section
In case of Absconding/ Terminated cases, profile is rejected

This step is done by the BHR after the candidates have uploaded the documents.

CIBIL check in Bureau One
The BHR fills in personal details of the candidate and pull out the credit score.
This report needs to be uploaded in the HR portal.
Acceptable CIBIL Scores are as under:
Threshold Score, 650
ZHR approval, 650-600
BHR Head Approval, 600-550
CHRO Approval, 550 and below

Refer Annexure, 10

7.2 For Group Functions and Wholesale Business

TA team / BHR looks after Interview panel composition.
TA team / BHR schedules the interview as per the common availability of the interview panel and candidate.
Interview stage / Level at Functional level:
FL - One (Reporting manager)
FML, Two (Reporting manager & respective Business Leader)
OL & above, Two (Business Leader & CE)
BHR interview is common across grade.
In the Interview Process panelists select/reject the candidates and Interview Evaluation Sheet (IES) is updated on the the HR portal by the TA team.

Offer Release

9.1 Process Description applicable to all non-frontline hirings

Offer Release
Offer released through the HR portal via email by the BHRs.
Steps to release the offer:
Login to the HR portal as Business-HR
Go to Talent Acquisition > Pre-joining > Update Offer
Mandatory fields to be populated as DOJ, Grade, Designation, IS, Earlier CTC, Offered CTC, Incentive / PLI role
Click on ‘Calculate & Save’. Then click on ‘Submit’. Then click on ‘Send Mail’ to trigger the offer letter to the candidate via e-mail

Offer Approval
If the CTC offered to the candidate is within the approval grid for the BHR, then no further checks are required and offer mail gets triggered automatically to the candidate.
In case the CTC offered to the candidate is beyond the approving authority at BHR level, the offer mail will not get triggered to the candidate automatically.
It will move to the “Offer Approval” stage for necessary deviation approval as per the below hiring grid, and approval e-mail will get triggered to the concerned approving authority automatically from the HR portal with the link to “Approve / Deny” the offer
Level 1: Zonal Head, HR
Level 2: Business Head, HR
Level 3: Compensation & Benefits Head
Level 4: CHRO
Once the offer is approved by the Approving authority, BHR needs to mail the offer letter to the candidate.
Steps to navigate are follows:
Login to the HR portal as Business-HR
Go to Talent Acquisition > Pre-joining > Print/Mail offer letter
All the requisitions for which offer letters are yet to be released will be visible here
Click on the drop-down in front of “Action” tab on the top right corner of the page, and select “Send Mail” from the drop-down
Click on the corresponding check-box in the “Action” column in front of the relevant requisition number, and then click on “Submit” to trigger the offer letter to the candidate

Offer Acceptance
Candidate receives link on email where they can accept the offer and confirm the Date of Joining
Candidate needs to accept the offer within 5 days of receiving the email
If Candidate does not accept the offer within 5 days, it will expire. BHR can revive the offer.
BHR can reactivate the expired offer using the below navigation:
Log-in to the HR portal as Business-HR > Talent Acquisition > Pre-joining > Offer Expired > Select the Req. No. > Select "Update" > Select number of days by which offer needs to be extended > Click on "Update"

Steps to Accept the Offer
Candidate can track their application status on home page against each position applied
Candidate needs to click on ‘Initiate Offer Acceptance’ to view the detailed offer letter and accept the offer or decline it
Detailed offer letter will be displayed in the next window
Click on ‘Download’ option to download the offer letter
Select ‘Offer Accepted’ and confirm on the Date of Joining
In case of Offer Declined, reason is mandatory
In case the candidate declines the offer, the remarks can be viewed by the Business-HR in the HR portal
Steps for Navigation: the HR portal > Talent Acquisition > Pre-joining > Offer Decline
A list of candidates, who have declined the offer is displayed.
In case candidate renegotiates the offer and the CTC components need to be changed, go to the ‘Offer Decline’, select the check box in front of the candidate, and submit to move candidate to ‘Offer Update’

Post Offer Release Process

10.1 Process Description applicable to all non-frontline hirings

Documentation Process & Profile Update
Candidate can update profile and upload documents by logging in the HR portal once Candidate ID is created.
Candidate receives the Login details on registered Email ID, stating Candidate ID and Link to update profile and upload documents.
Steps to Upload documents:
When a candidate is selected, he shall receive a notification for the same and a link will be provided to upload the documents
Click on ‘Initiate Documentation Verification’ to upload documents
A list of documents required to be uploaded will be displayed. Candidate needs to upload the mandatory documents by clicking on ‘Pending’
Refer Annexure, 11
Once the required documents are uploaded, click on “Submit”
Once the candidate has uploaded all the required documents, the BHR can view the same
Steps for Navigation are as follows
Login to the HR portal as Business-HR
Go to Talent Acquisition > Appointment > Upload Post-offer Documents
On every milestone completed, the candidate will be notified via email

For detailed the HR portal Navigation for TA module, Refer Annexure, 12

Approval of Profile through HR Ops Team
All details entered and documents uploaded are verified and profile is approved by HR Ops Team
In case of discrepancy, the profile is sent back to the Candidate and BHR for rectification
Candidate needs to rectify the discrepancies and submit the profile again.
This is process is completed within 1 working day after the candidates have submitted their profile.
For the Navigation steps, please refer the Onboarding Process Policy.

Payment to Talent Partner
It is only applicable for the indents which are closed via consultants.
While it is advised to use cost effective channels, choice of use of the available channels may become critical at times from the point of view of TAT and the required numbers and speed of hiring/onboarding.
The TA team is responsible for this step and the payments are made within 30 days from the DOJ of the candidate

Onboarding

11.1 Process Description applicable to all non-frontline hirings

Confirm/Update the Date of Joining
When candidate joins on ground, his DOJ is updated by BHR in the HR portal
The Steps for Navigation are as follows:
Login to the HR portal as Business-HR
Go to Talent Acquisition > Appointment > Click on Confirm/ Update Date of Joining
In the next window, click on the checkbox and update the Date of Joining
Date of Joining can be updated for multiple candidates
Click on ‘Submit’ when Date of Joining is confirmed

PS ID creation
After Date of Joining is confirmed by BHR, PS ID is created by HR Ops Team
SMS is triggered from the HR portal to candidate confirming, PS ID and AD password
E-mail ID and password
Date of Joining
Mail is triggered from the HR portal to IS and BHR informing about joining of candidate with details such as PS ID, DOJ, Location and IS details.
Please refer the Onboarding Process Policy for the Navigation steps.

| Car Policy
|
Applicability
| Applicable to all full-time employees of Meridian Finance & all registered legal entities under the umbrella.
|
Coverage
| Company Car Policy (CCP) for Group Executive Committee (GEC)
Company owned car scheme (COCS) for non-GEC.

This Policy document is meant to establish the guiding principles that help govern how employees may avail the car benefits as applicable under the relevant schemes (Company-Owned Car Scheme or Employee-Owned Car Scheme). It outlines the guidelines on the reimbursement and settlement procedure on the various Car policy available for the employees to opt for.

Any questions and suggestions on the implementation of the policy should be directed to the ‘Authorized Personnel’ as mentioned in Clause 1.1.1.

For the purpose of this document, the term ‘company’ would refer to Meridian Finance & all registered legal entities under the umbrella.

Please note that this policy version shall supersede all earlier versions. Meridian Finance will endeavour to update this policy as required.
